Overview**The Problem**
---------------


Flock's creative group is expanding as the company raises its standard of visual storytelling and campaign execution across brand, film, and digital experiences. This momentum creates a need for unified creative leadership to turn complex technology and public safety outcomes into compelling, human\-centered narratives. You will own that direction, driving the creative concept, visual identity, and craft bar across design, film, and motion.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


* Direct integrated campaigns, product launch narratives, and flagship brand films from initial concept through final delivery.
* Define and maintain the visual, cinematic, and editorial standards across design, motion, and video production to build a recognizable creative signature.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary craft teams, guiding discipline leads in art direction, storytelling, and creative critique.
* Establish operational systems, including reference libraries, templates, and production guidelines, that elevate quality while improving delivery speed.
* Partner with brand strategy and production leadership to translate executive goals into clear creative briefs and execution plans.

**What This Role is Not**
-------------------------


* This is not a hands\-off review role, you will actively shape concepts, guide edits, direct art execution, and refine details across all mediums.
* This isn't a high\-volume template production management job, your main focus is establishing concept quality and narrative depth.
* This is not an isolated brand strategy position, you will work directly alongside production and cross\-functional teams to ship live campaigns.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary creative teams across art direction, design, motion, and cinematic film production.
* Deep portfolio demonstrating high\-craft visual design alongside narrative documentary or high\-paced commercial storytelling.
* Advanced fluency in the complete production lifecycle, including typography, editing pace, color grading, sound design, and finishing standards.
* Experience setting practical brand guidelines, design systems, and creative review frameworks for internal teams and agency partners.
* Ability to direct campaigns that balance emotional human narrative with clear technical product messaging.

**Compensation**
----------------


In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $200,000 and$250,000 as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.


**Why Flock**
=============

Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.


Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub\-based roles mean real in\-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.


the impossible takes every kind of mind. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.


On compensation: we pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.


One last thing: all legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.


Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

description:
Eurest
   

  

**Position Title: National Director of Brand Experience \& Growth**
**Salary: $155000 \- $175000**
**Other Forms of Compensation: 10% Bonus**
 As the leader in business and industry dining, Eurest is the company to join if you want a rewarding career packed with limitless opportunities. We feed the employees of the nation's largest and most\-prestigious companies \-\- in every state and across all industries. As a member of Eurest's leadership and professional support team, you will help our 16,000 chefs, and in\-unit associates excel as they deliver world\-class meals in corporate cafes and executive dining rooms with on\-site catering through vending innovations and more.
   

  

 Our company is innovative, high performing and fast growing. Our teammates are enthusiastic, committed to quality and thrive on consistently delivering unparalleled results. And did we mention we work with exciting companies and at interesting locations? Come grow your career with Eurest.
   

  

 Position Purpose
   

  

 The National Director of Brand Experience \& Growth serves as the enterprise owner of growth marketing, customer engagement strategy, and brand experience activation for Compass One at Amazon. The role is accountable for increasing participation, strengthening retention, improving market adoption of strategic programs, and maximizing the business impact of marketing investments.
   

  

 Success requires direct leadership of Marketing Field Managers and strong influence across operations, culinary, finance, digital, analytics, strategic projects, and client\-facing stakeholders. This leader sets priorities, strengthens communication consistency, reduces duplication, and translates enterprise strategy into practical field execution.
   

  

 This is a hybrid position that requires a minimum of three days per week in the office. To effectively support the strategic objectives and operational demands of the role, the preferred candidate will be based in Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC. The position also requires up to 25% travel, based on business needs and organizational priorities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Leadership and Influence**
* Lead the national brand experience and growth strategy across Compass One at Amazon locations, setting direction for priorities, standards, outcomes, and field execution expectations.
* Influence operations, culinary, digital, finance, analytics, strategic projects, and client stakeholders to advance shared growth objectives and prioritize customer engagement initiatives.
* Lead national growth reviews with operational leadership to align performance, adoption, barriers, and next actions across markets and operating regions.
* Establish scorecards, governance routines, accountability, and decision rights for growth and brand activation.
* Ensure local execution aligns with enterprise standards, customer experience goals, communication requirements, and national growth priorities.
* Drive accountability for campaign deployment, growth initiative adoption, and follow\-through across direct and indirect teams.
* Directly manage Marketing Field Managers, providing leadership, prioritization, coaching, and accountability for disciplined execution.
* Serve as the executive subject matter expert for brand experience, growth enablement, customer communication strategy, and client\-appropriate storytelling.
* Develop data\-backed narratives and client\-ready recommendations that translate insights into strategic direction and change management plans.


**Growth Leadership**
* Own the national growth framework across priority strategic programs, including annual plans, market\-level targets, and measurable business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to increase participation, frequency, transaction size, customer retention, and adoption across priority programs and markets.
* Develop customer segmentation strategies and targeted activation plans that translate insights into practical growth actions.
* Partner with operations leaders to convert marketing initiatives, brand activations, and customer engagement strategies into measurable sales growth.
* Identify underperforming programs, recommend corrective actions, and align cross\-functional partners around execution priorities.
* Develop predictive frameworks that identify future growth opportunities and inform prioritization.


**Strategic Growth and Brand Activation**
* Develop brand activation strategies aligned with business, client, customer, retail, catering, and culinary priorities.
* Develop annual retail traffic and transaction strategies with operations and culinary teams to increase adoption, merchandising effectiveness, and promotional impact.
* Develop annual catering growth plans with the National Director of Catering Growth, including seasonal campaigns, LTO support, customer acquisition, awareness, and national marketing alignment.
* Translate customer insights, trends, workplace experience drivers, and performance data into recommendations that improve participation, engagement, and program adoption.
* Own marketing content, campaign assets, graphic materials, templates, customer\-facing communication tools, and promotional support materials.
* Build scalable campaign models that support consistent implementation with appropriate market flexibility.
* Evaluate marketing and communication investments to improve impact, efficiency, growth contribution, and return on resources.
* Partner with Data \& Analytics to measure initiative performance across participation, satisfaction, sales, adoption, margin, retail traffic, transaction, and catering performance data.


**Operational Enablement**
* Partner with field operations to simplify execution, reduce duplication, and improve consistency of brand and communication initiatives.
* Coordinate field support across culinary, wellness, analytics, strategic projects, operations, and digital teams.
* Use data and operator feedback to refine campaigns, remove barriers, and improve adoption across markets.
* Standardize repeatable work while preserving local flexibility for market\-specific customer needs and innovation.


**Functional Execution**
 This role translates national brand experience and growth strategy into practical, repeatable execution across markets. The focus is to improve awareness, adoption, customer engagement, operator enablement, and ROI through disciplined planning, data\-driven prioritization, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Mindset: Anticipates future customer, client, and business needs and translates them into scalable brand experience and growth strategies.
* Business Insight: Applies knowledge of business drivers, financial performance, customer behavior, and market dynamics to prioritize high\-impact work.
* Executive Communication and Thought Leadership: Communicates complex insights through clear, data\-backed, client\-ready narratives.
* Influence and Collaboration: Builds trust, aligns stakeholders, and advances shared objectives across functions.
* Driving Results: Converts strategy into measurable action, maintains momentum through ambiguity, and delivers outcomes through direct and indirect teams.
* Ensuring Accountability: Establishes clear ownership, decision rights, scorecards, and follow\-through mechanisms that support disciplined execution.
* Manages Ambiguity: Operates effectively where priorities, ownership, and execution paths require alignment.
* Customer\-Centric Innovation: Uses customer feedback, operator insight, and market trends to improve the experience, test new ideas, and scale effective solutions.
* Change Leadership: Guides stakeholders through new standards, campaigns, platforms, and ways of working with clear communication and practical enablement.


**Qualifications**

* 7\+ years of senior marketing, brand, communications, growth, or customer experience leadership experience; B2B and B2C experience required, B2B2C experience preferred.
* Strong business and financial acumen, quantitative fluency, creative problem\-solving, executive communication, stakeholder influence, change management, and the ability to lead direct and indirect teams in a matrixed environment.

**Role Purpose**



Run the creative function day to day so that brand and creative output ships on deadline and at a consistent standard — without the EVP acting as the bottleneck. The EVP owns brand direction and holds the creative pen on high\-stakes work; this role organizes the team, enforces the standard, manages the people, and executes. It is an operator's seat: part player, mostly coach.


**Core Responsibilities**


* **Own creative intake, prioritization, and deadlines** across every channel, so nothing stalls waiting on the EVP.
* **Manage and** develop the Lead Creative and the freelance roster; set expectations, give feedback, and hold the team to delivery.
* **Build and maintain creative systems —** Figma component libraries, templates, and brand\-asset governance so quality scales without bespoke effort every time.
* **Act as guardian of brand consistency —** enforcing the EVP's standard across departments and catching drift before it ships.
* **Partner cross\-functionally with demand generation, product,** events, and partnerships to translate their needs into creative that lands on time.

We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. As the **Art Director, Performance** at Upstart, you’ll create high\-impact creative across our Paid Social channels, including Meta, TikTok, Google, and emerging channels. Partnering closely with Marketing and Creative, you’ll develop best\-in\-class work across evergreen and influencer programs with both in\-house teams and external agency partners. description:
**Role:** Art Director
  

**Team:** Graphic Design


**Scope:** Individual Contributor, P4


**Years of Experience:** 5\+


**Location:** Ventura, CA (Hybrid)  



  

As the Art Director for Apparel Graphics, you will help shape and execute the visual direction of graphics across Patagonia apparel collections. You will translate seasonal ideas, brand storytelling and product needs into original artwork, typography, color and graphic systems that are compelling, consistent and ready for production. Working closely with product line managers, designers, developers and marketing, you will guide creative work from concept through final execution. Your ability to create meaningful, durable graphics and explore responsible applications will support Patagonia’s work to save our home planet.


**What You’ll Do**

* Create and art direct seasonal apparel graphics that express Patagonia’s brand identity, product stories and creative point of view across assigned categories.
* Translate seasonal themes and creative briefs into original artwork, typography, color strategies, trims and cohesive graphic concepts.
* Partner with Product Line Management, apparel designers, development and marketing teams to align graphics with product, brand, production and sales timelines.
* Balance hands\-on design with art direction, providing clear feedback to internal designers, external creatives and agency or freelance partners as assigned.
* Prepare artwork for screen print, embroidery and specialty applications, working with graphic development partners to ensure creative intent, quality and production feasibility.
* Review and approve artwork strike\-offs and revisions, resolving creative or technical issues while keeping work on schedule.
* Support artist commissioning, artwork licensing and related cost discussions when projects require external creative partners.
* Research cultural, artistic, market and competitive influences while protecting Patagonia’s brand heritage and avoiding trend\-for\-trend’s\-sake design.
* Explore opportunities to improve materials, techniques and graphic applications with consideration for quality, longevity and environmental impact.
* Present concepts and creative rationale clearly, manage multiple projects and maintain consistent communication throughout the design process.

**Who You Are**

* **Conceptual** : You can turn an open\-ended theme or product story into a clear, original visual idea.
* **Hands\-On** : You enjoy making the work as much as guiding it and can move comfortably between concept, design and refinement.
* **Collaborative** : You build trust across creative, product and development partners and use feedback to strengthen the work.
* **Discerning** : You bring strong taste and judgment in illustration, typography, color, composition and brand expression.
* **Practical** : You understand that successful creative work must also meet production, quality, cost and timeline requirements.
* **Curious** : You stay connected to art, culture, apparel and emerging creative practices while maintaining an authentic brand perspective.
* **Clear** : You communicate creative intent, feedback and decisions in ways that help others move the work forward.
* **Mission\-Aligned** : You care about responsible design, product longevity and Patagonia’s purpose to save our home planet.

**Experience You Bring**

* 5\+ years of apparel graphics, graphic design, art direction or closely related creative experience, with a portfolio demonstrating concept development and successful final execution.
* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, fine art, industrial arts or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and other relevant design tools.
* Strong capabilities in original artwork, illustration, typography, color strategy and visual storytelling.
* Working knowledge of apparel graphics production, including screen print, embroidery, trims, specialty applications and artwork preparation.
* Experience partnering with product creation or development teams and responding to technical, cost, quality and timeline constraints.
* Experience art directing or providing creative feedback to internal or external designers, illustrators or artists.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-moving, collaborative environment.
* Experience with outdoor, sport, lifestyle or global consumer brands is preferred.
* Familiarity with responsible design practices, innovative art applications, artist licensing or outdoor communities is a plus.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
------------


Circle is building the world’s leading AI\-powered, all\-in\-one platform for digital businesses. We make it possible for creators, coaches, educators, and businesses to bring together their audience with engaging discussions, live streams, events, chat, courses, and payments — all in one place, all under their own brand.


We’re proud to be a fully remote company of around 270 (and growing!) team members from 30\+ countries around the world. We seek exceptional individuals around the world, set them up to do the best work of their lives, and in turn, create a meaningful impact in their own lives. We don't track hours, but we do manage for high expectations very closely. We collaborate across time zones, are highly async, and like to document a lot.


Twice a year, we bring the whole company together in beautiful places around the world for our company offsites. So far, we’ve hosted offsites in Turkey, Portugal, Mexico, Thailand, Colombia, Italy, Ireland, and more, with still more to come!


Check out our **Careers** page for more about working at Circle.

**About the role**
------------------

**We’re excited to bring on Circle’s first Creative Director.**


This is a unique opportunity to shape how Circle shows up in the world, and define the story of a generational company building the future of digital businesses.


We’re looking for an exceptional creative storyteller who can help us develop strong, consistent narratives across everything Circle puts into the world: product launches, campaigns, ads, landing pages, announcements, partnerships, events, and more.


You obsess over the power of a great narrative. You believe every word, visual, and detail matters. You have an exceptionally high creative bar, thrive in highly collaborative environments, and know how to influence people through the quality of the work itself.


As Circle’s first Creative Director, you’ll first and foremost act as a creative extension of the founders. You will turn their ideas, product strategy, and company vision into narratives that are clear, memorable, and unmistakably Circle across all our assets.


On a day\-to\-day basis, you’ll work closely with Circle’s founders and across our in\-house design studio, product marketing, paid media, video, and events teams to elevate our storytelling and creative execution across every major moment.

**Your goal is to help make Circle one of the most creatively distinct and definitive companies in the category of digital businesses.**

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* **Shape Circle’s narrative.** Work closely with Circle’s founders to synthesize, sharpen, and evolve the story behind our long\-term vision, and translate it into clear, compelling narratives that can travel across everything we do.
* **Own the creative direction of our biggest launches and campaigns.** Find the angle, develop the brief, shape the story, and obsess over how we make each moment stand out. You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing across launches, announcements, demos, and enablement to ensure everything feels cohesive, intentional, and unmistakably Circle. Doing this well requires developing a deep understanding of our product, customers, and market.
* **Be a deeply embedded creative marketing partner to our design studio.** You’ll work especially closely with our Design Studio, which is led by one of Circle’s co\-founders and won’t report to you. Success here involves shared taste, mutual trust, healthy creative tension, and the ability to move quickly together. You’ll occasionally lead external agencies as well — and when the moment calls for it, write the high\-stakes copy yourself: the headline, manifesto, launch script, or line someone delivers on stage.
* **Raise the bar on our advertising and creative campaigns.** Develop the concepts and narratives behind Circle’s ad creative, partnering up our Paid Acquisition team to turn them into high\-performing campaigns. They’ll bring the channel and media\-buying expertise; while you can make sure the creative is worth paying to distribute.
* **Direct how our stories come to life across video and events.** Get hands\-on with scripts, structure, pacing, and narrative for launch films, social, ads, virtual summits, and other major moments. You won’t be editing videos or producing events yourself, but you’ll understand the craft well enough to have strong opinions about what works in each medium, and collaborate deeply with the specialists who bring it to life.
* **Influence the narrative behind brand experiences people remember across our webinars, virtual summits, conferences, and live events to align with company brand vision.** This includes everything from the theme and programming to the booth, talks, slides, copy, and small details nobody else would think to obsess over.
* **Turn partnerships into stories.** Work with our Partnerships team to make more of our collaborations with creators and customers into stories we can distribute across our channels. You can help develop the concept, framing, name, narrative, and creative execution behind our biggest partnerships, and helping our partners tell those stories powerfully themselves.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **A body of work you’re genuinely proud of.** We care far more about what you’ve made than the titles you’ve held or the number of years you’ve been doing it. You should be able to walk us through your best work piece by piece: the problem, the idea, the choices you made, what you personally contributed, and ultimately, whether it worked.
* **Exceptional creative taste and judgment.** You know great work when you see it, can articulate *why* it’s great, and have the conviction to push work until it gets there. Just as importantly, you know when an idea is trying too hard, when something is off\-brand, and when your own fingerprints are making the work worse rather than better.
* **You’re an exceptional storyteller and writer.** You can take something complicated and find the simple, compelling story inside it. You care deeply about language and will happily obsess over a headline, a launch narrative, or a single line of copy until it feels inevitable.
* **A strong point of view, and the ability to make it better through collaboration.** We don’t want someone who waits for a brief and executes it. We want someone who can tell us what the brief *should* be, challenge the premise when necessary, elevate ideas coming from the team and our founders, and make a compelling case for a different direction.
* **Real fluency in video as a creative medium.** You don’t need to shoot, edit, animate, or produce. But you should deeply understand what makes video work, from the script and opening seconds to structure, pacing, emotion, and payoff. You should also understand why a great launch film, social video, customer story, and paid ad require very different creative choices.
* **Experience making creative that has to perform.** You’ve developed ads and campaigns where the work was ultimately accountable to results. You’ve seen the numbers, learned from them, iterated because of them, and know how to partner with paid acquisition teams without allowing performance marketing to turn into boring marketing.
* **An instinct for getting attention without going off script.** You understand how to make a brand noticeable, surprising, and culturally relevant without chasing attention for its own sake. Ideally, you can show us a creative risk you fought for that worked, and another you talked the room out of because it wasn’t right for the brand.
* **The ability to lead through influence, not hierarchy.** There’s no large creative organization reporting to you. Much of your impact will come from getting exceptional work out of designers, marketers, writers, video producers, agencies, and founders who don’t report to you. You know how to raise the creative bar without becoming a bottleneck.
* **A great eye for design and deep respect for the craft.** You don’t need to be a designer, but you should be able to work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with exceptional ones. Our Design Studio is led by a co\-founder and operates with a very high bar; you’ll need the visual taste, vocabulary, and collaborative instincts to be a trusted creative partner to that team.
* **Experience working closely with founders.** You’re comfortable working with founders who care deeply about the product, brand, and details. You will need to extract the vision, challenge it when needed, and turn it into something better than either of you would have arrived at independently.
* **An obsession with understanding what how to tell the world about we do and why it matters.** The best creative work here will come from understanding Circle at a deep level: our product, customers, competitors, category, and where the market is going. You should genuinely enjoy developing that level of context rather than treating it as somebody else’s job.
* **Exceptional communication skills.** Circle is global, remote, and highly asynchronous. You’ll need outstanding written and verbal English (CEFR C2 or equivalent), and the ability to make your thinking clear enough that great work can move forward even when everyone isn’t in the same room.

**Compensation \& benefits**
----------------------------


Circle offers U.S.\-benchmarked compensation globally, equity in the company with ongoing refresh grants, and 35 days of paid time off each year.


We’re a remote\-only team that comes together twice a year for company retreats in incredible destinations around the world. Alongside incredible flexibility and autonomy, we offer a benefits package that supports health, wellbeing, and professional growth. Learn more in our Candidate Hub.

**Learn more**
--------------

* **Candidate Safety \& Interview Process Notice**
* **Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**
* **How We Use Candidate Data**
* **Equal Employment Opportunity**
* Visit our **Candidate Hub** to learn more about working at Circle, our benefits, and our hiring process.

title: Head of Creative
description:
**Location**:


Remote  


**About the Role**


The Head of Creative sets the creative standard across three studios — Concept Development, Content \& Production, and Performance Creative — and is accountable for how the work comes together across all of them. This is a player\-coach role, and the play is division\-wide. You lead the Studio Owners, who own craft and quality inside their own studios, while you own how the studios sync: where handoffs happen, where dependencies collide, and whether the combined output meets client expectations.


You’ll set narrative and visual standards company\-wide, lead a multi\-disciplinary creative organization that moves fast and produces work that feels fresh, and hold the seams together where studio work integrates. Creative excellence matters here, and so does what it delivers for clients.


**What You’ll Own**


**Creative Vision \+ Standards**


* Set the creative vision and quality bar for the division, building in each Studio Owner’s craft standards
* Own the framework used to evaluate creative output across all three studios, so creative excellence means the same thing everywhere
* Serve as the company’s single point of accountability on creative — client expectations, market shifts, and cross\-studio handoffs
* Oversee campaigns, launches, and creative systems that span more than one studio
* Put AI\-assisted creative tools and emerging tech to work to improve speed and quality of output


**Multi\-Craft Leadership \+ Mentorship**


* Lead the three creative craft lanes — Concept Development, Content \& Production, Performance Creative — and hold them to the standards above
* Resolve conflicts, handoffs, and dependencies between studios
* Keep storytelling, design, and campaign deployment under one creative authority instead of competing silos
* Coach and develop the creative team, setting the bar for craft and cross\-functional collaboration
* Build a culture of energy, ambition, and craft that Studio Owners carry into their own teams
* Protect the team from scope chaos and hold the line on labor margins


**Business Strategy \+ Cross\-Discipline Partnership**


* Own creative margin performance across the division
* Design systems and workflows — including AI\-assisted ones — that address efficiency and capacity pressure
* Work with brand strategy and research leadership to refine the systems to turn positioning and audience insight into briefs the team can build from
* Partner with digital experience and web teams so brand systems carry cleanly into digital environments
* Coordinate with paid media and activation teams so campaign systems scale across audiences and platforms
* Act as a senior creative voice in high\-stakes client presentations, new business pitches, and scope development


**Team Management**


* Lead, coach, and develop the creative team to foster high performance and professional growth
* Set clear expectations, provide ongoing feedback, and deliver timely performance evaluations
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
* Identify development opportunities and support team members in reaching their career goals


**What You Bring**


* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, graphic design, fine arts, communications, or a related field, or equivalent life/work experience
* Master’s degree (MFA/MBA) welcome, but a proven portfolio and track record leading teams matter most
* 7\+ years of creative leadership, brand marketing, or multi\-channel campaign development experience
* Expert\-level storytelling, campaign architecture, and multi\-channel production skills, applied to large creative teams and agency\-wide initiatives
* Track record of pulling design, copy, video, digital, and social into one cohesive operating model
* Experience diagnosing and improving team\-level profitability — pricing, scoping, staffing mix — not just maintaining a margin that’s already healthy
* Experience driving efficiency and capacity through process and technology, including AI\-assisted tools, as an alternative to headcount growth, particularly for teams under sustained workload pressure
* Executive\-level knowledge of brand management and integrated marketing strategy, and how creative output connects to business priorities and customer experience
* Ability to energize creative teams and raise craft standards in a fast\-paced, pragmatic agency environment
* Strong communication and time\-management skills, along with comfort switching between multiple technology platforms, given the remote environment
* Ability to sit at a desk and work on a computer for extended periods


**Why This Role**


Creative is a value multiplier at Carnegie, and this is the person who makes sure three strong studios add up to one coherent creative organization. You’ll have final say on how work comes together across studios, three Studio Owners to lead and hold to a shared bar, and room to decide how AI and new ways of working reshape the division’s capacity and speed. Whoever takes this on owns both the work that reaches clients and the business behind it — margin, efficiency, and how well the whole division runs, not just how good any one piece of it looks.



#### **About Carnegie**


For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

  


No phone calls or unscheduled visits to the office, please. Carnegie is an equal\-opportunity employer.

* High\-Intent Content Strategy: Collaborate with the Product Marketing and Brand teams to build and optimize localized, compliant fintech content targeting high\-intent, converting keywords.


**Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) \& AI Visibility**


* AI Search Strategy: Develop N26's framework for GEO, optimizing web presence to maximize brand recommendation, inclusion, and positive sentiment in AI\-generated answers (e.g., ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
* Knowledge Graph \& Entity Management: Optimize structured data (Schema.org), digital entity relationships, and authoritative external references to establish N26 as the definitive financial authority for LLMs.
* Citation \& Share of Voice Monitoring: Establish benchmarks, tracking metrics, and custom tools to measure N26's share of AI voice (SoAIV) and recommendation rates against competitors in conversational search.


**Analytics, Testing \& Reporting**


* Performance Tracking: Deliver standard organic acquisition dashboards tracking organic traffic, sign\-ups, and keyword/entity rankings.
* Testing \& Experimentation: Run continuous A/B and multivariate tests on title tags, semantic markup, content structuring, and internal linking to drive conversion rate optimization (CRO) and crawl efficiency.
* Market Insights: Monitor algorithm updates, AI model updates, and regulatory shifts to proactively adapt our growth tactics.

**What you need to be successful:**
-----------------------------------


* Experience: 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in SEO within high\-growth tech companies, fintechs, or large\-scale consumer digital products across multi\-language markets.
* GEO \& AI Search Mastery: Proven understanding of how Large Language Models (LLMs) ingest, index, and cite web sources, alongside practical experience optimizing content for AI platforms.
* Technical Proficiency: Strong command of HTML/CSS, technical SEO auditing tools (Screaming Frog, Log analysis, etc.), dynamic rendering, and structured data implementation.
* Data Fluency: Advanced knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), Ahrefs, Semrush, and SQL/Python/R (a plus for large dataset analysis and API integrations).
* Language: Fluent written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a strong advantage.


**Nice\-to\-Haves**


* Experience working with programmatic SEO and automated content workflows.
* Familiarity with vector databases, semantic search embeddings, and RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) concepts.
* Experience in App Store Optimization (ASO) for iOS and Android.

  


**What's in it for you:**
-------------------------


Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors * .
* Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness \& wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
* As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
* Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies \- all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
* A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

**Who we are**
--------------



N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.



We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.



We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500\-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.


**Do you see yourself thriving in this role?** We'd love to see your application even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!


**Equal opportunities for all**



At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

title: Director Of Revenue Operations
description:
**Director Of Revenue Operations \| Based in Barcelona**  

  

Kantox is a Barcelona\-based fintech acquired by BNP Paribas in 2022\. As Director of Revenue Operations, you will sit at the intersection of internal commercial execution and parent company alignment, reporting directly to the Chief Commercial Officer.


This is not a coordination role. You will own the RevOps function, lead the relationship with BNP Paribas commercial leadership, and drive the commercial initiatives that determine how Kantox scales.

**What you will work on**


Strategic Leadership

* Working hand in hand with the Chief Commercial Officer
* Building strategic reviews and recommendations for key meetings including Strategic Reviews with BNP, Kantox Board meetings, and Quarterly Commercial meetings
* Ensuring all decisions made in the Commercial leadership team are executed seamlessly, in collaboration with Sales Team Managers
* Orchestrating the work of all teams represented in the commercial organisation: Business Development, Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, and Marketing
* Managing partnerships with third parties: animating those partnerships to extract the best of them, defining and executing processes to work efficiently with partners, and leading the training of the commercial team around those partnerships


People Leadership

* Leading the Revenue Operations team (current organisation: 1 Sales Operations Specialist, 1 Implementation and Customer Specialist, 1 Marketing Specialist, 2 Quality Assurance Specialists, and 2 Salesforce Developers)
* Building and developing your Revenue Operations team: establishing clear career pathways, identifying skill gaps, and driving upskilling in areas like CRM, analytics, and process design
* Fostering career development and internal mobility: identifying high\-potential team members, creating stretch assignments and mentoring opportunities, and supporting movement across the commercial function
* Driving team engagement and culture: celebrating wins and ensuring your team understands how their work connects to commercial and organisational strategy


BNP Paribas Commercial Relations

* Representing the commercial organisation in recurrent BNPP stakeholder meetings: preparing agendas, presenting KPIs, deal status, and pipeline intelligence
* Coordinating efforts across local markets with Kantox and BNP local sales to ensure execution of the priorities defined in regular Kantox/BNPP meetings
* Managing BNP compliance and risk requests related to the commercial organisation including process improvement and executing internal audit recommendations


AI and Productivity

* Recommending new workflows for Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, and Revenue Operations leveraging AI
* Making the best of our tech stack using the AI capabilities of our providers
* Increasing sales closing ratio by enhancing the sales cycle with AI


Key Commercial Meetings

* Owning the organisation and content of key internal commercial meetings: sales kickoffs, quarterly commercial committee, and weekly Sales meetings
* Acting as a speaker at those events to give a clear vision of the commercial organisation's direction


Budget, Targets, and Compensation

* Participating in budget preparation with Finance and Senior Sales Management
* Designing commission plans with the CCO and following their proper execution
* Leveraging and administering SPIFF programs


Revenue Operations

* Being fully responsible for the reliability of all reporting for Senior Management, mainly Power BI and Salesforce dashboards, with the support of our Power BI specialists
* Overseeing the full RevOps tech stack including CRM, sales tools, and analytics, alongside team development and process optimisation
* Designing and driving revenue operations initiatives across sales process improvement, continuous training, forecasting accuracy, pricing strategies, and operational efficiency
* Ensuring the forecasting process is followed diligently across the commercial organisation, with clear accountability at every stage of the pipeline
* Driving continuous improvement across all key sales velocity metrics: pipeline size, average deal size, closing ratio, and sales cycle length
* Aligning Sales, Customer Success, and Implementation to ensure seamless handoffs, successful client onboarding, and consistent commercial execution
* Making data\-driven recommendations to evolve the sales cycle based on the evolution of the product, market, and competitive landscape

**The setup**


You will be based in our Barcelona office, working in a hybrid model and reporting directly to the CCO. You will lead a high\-performing Revenue Operations team and work closely with senior stakeholders both inside Kantox and within BNP Paribas. This is a role with real strategic weight and direct influence on how Kantox grows.

 **Who you are**


You have deep experience in revenue operations or commercial planning, and you know how to manage complex stakeholder relationships at C\-Level. You are equally comfortable presenting forecasts to senior leadership and getting into the detail of a CRM process improvement. You lead teams with clarity, build cross\-functional alignment, and operate effectively inside structured governance environments.


Concretely:

* 7\+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or commercial planning, preferably in SaaS
* Outstanding reliability: anything going through you will be properly executed by your team
* Proven experience managing strategic relationships with C\-Level stakeholders
* Strong financial acumen across budget planning, forecasting, revenue recognition, and KPI analysis
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable engaging senior executives and speaking in public forums
* Proven hands\-on experience with Salesforce
* Experience leading teams and driving cross\-functional initiatives in a scaling organisation
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail and comfort with complex governance structures
* Fluent in English

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in fintech, banking, or financial services
* Familiarity with large financial institutions such as banking groups or asset managers
* Background in FX, treasury, or trade finance operations

**What we offer**

* Competitive base salary and bonus
* Sponsored learning and development budget
* Free private health insurance
* Free language lessons (Spanish, English and French)
* Relocation package if required
* Flexible working hours and short Fridays
* Hybrid working model (4 office, 1 home)
* 36 days of annual leave
* Gym discounts and free sports activities
* Restaurant Ticket with monthly credit and regular cross\-team lunches
* Fresh fruit and unlimited coffee
* Pizza Fridays
* Barcelona office with 360° views of the city

**About Kantox**


We are a 200\-person fintech and a BNP Paribas company, with offices in London and Barcelona. We built a product that handles real financial complexity for clients who depend on it every day. As we deepen our integration with BNP Paribas and scale our commercial operations globally, this role sits at the centre of that ambition.

**Kantox is an equal opportunity employer.** We hire on merit and welcome applicants regardless of background, nationality, gender, age, sexual orientation, or disability status.

title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Benelux) - Orbit Program
description:

title: Head of Pricing and Monetization
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**


n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.


Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation

  

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.


We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


Your main goal will be to turn n8n's pricing and packaging into a deliberate, data\-informed growth lever \- one that scales revenue and adoption across our entire go\-to\-market, from our 1\.5 million\-strong community to global Enterprise accounts.


To do so, here's what you'll own:

**BUILD THE ANALYTICAL FOUNDATION FOR PRICING**

* Build and own the model connecting unit economics, agent run cost, willingness\-to\-pay, gross margin, and customer value.
* Maintain competitive and market intelligence so our pricing keeps pace with a category that's shifting fast.
* Run pricing experiments and turn the results into documented, reusable learnings.

**DESIGN OUR PRICING \& PACKAGING ARCHITECTURE**

* Shape plan design and packaging across our community, self\-serve, and Enterprise tiers, plus add\-ons like our startup and charity plans.
* Design pricing for new SKUs and consumption\-based models as our product and cost\-to\-serve evolve around AI Assistant and n8n Connect.
* Build packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use directly to launch new features.

**DRIVE AND ROLL OUT PRICING DECISIONS**

* Lead cross\-functional pricing decision\-making and secure buy\-in across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and Data.
* Own the rollout of major pricing changes end\-to\-end, from decision to launch to measured impact.
* Build and own our pricing frameworks: list pricing, discount guardrails, decision rubrics, grandfathering rules, and usage\-based billing decisions.

**Requirements**

**Must\-have**

* **Pricing leadership in B2B SaaS**: You have 6\+ years in pricing, monetisation, or commercial strategy, including at least one full cycle leading a major pricing model transition — subscription to consumption, seat\-based to usage\-based, or a platform repricing.
* **Hands\-on with modern pricing models**: You've personally designed and rolled out consumption\-based, outcome\-based, or AI\-native pricing at a company past $100M ARR.
* **Both self\-serve and Enterprise motions**: You've owned pricing on both sides of the funnel — self\-serve/PLG (activation, conversion, tier design, funnel experimentation) *and* Enterprise, sales\-led (packaging for large accounts, deal economics, discount governance). n8n monetises both, so fluency in one motion only isn't enough.
* **Deep analytical rigour**: You build the financial model yourself and reason fluently about unit economics, cost\-to\-serve, gross margin, willingness\-to\-pay, and elasticity.
* **Billing fluency, technical and operational**: You understand event metering, rating, entitlements, proration, overage, and revenue recognition well enough to design pricing that's actually operable — and you've partnered with a Billing function on invoicing, dunning, true\-ups, and disputes.
* **Empathy for technical users and buyers**: You understand where, how, and why developers and technical buyers assign value across a product experience.
* **Frameworks over bottlenecks**: You've built packaging frameworks and decision tools that product teams use independently, rather than routing every pricing decision through you.
* **Cross\-functional influence**: You bring Product, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Billing into alignment on contentious commercial decisions.
* **Motivated by scope, not headcount**: You're energised by owning a global, high\-stakes topic as an individual contributor, with analytical support from Data and RevOps and rollout support from Program Management.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* **Formal pricing training**: You've been trained at Simon\-Kucher or the pricing practice of another consultancy, and you bring that rigour with you.
* **Developer tools experience**: You've priced products sold to engineers and technical teams.
* **Open source or freemium background**: You know how to design pricing that converts a free community into paying customers without breaking trust.

### **Why join us?**


At n8n, pricing won't be an afterthought argued about in the margins of someone else's roadmap \- it'll be your function to build. You'll be our first dedicated pricing hire, which means low\-hanging fruit everywhere and real scope to shape how a $5\.2bn company monetises across community, self\-serve, and Enterprise, in 100\+ countries and across both cloud and self\-hosted. You'll work directly with leaders in Product, Sales, Finance, and RevOps, and you'll see your decisions land in our ARR in months, not years. You'll join a supportive, remote\-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.


Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?


Apply now \- and help us build the future of automation.

*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.*

***Our company language is English.***

*You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity\-inclusion\-and\-belonging\-n8n\-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).*

***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.*

**Benefits**
------------

* **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay.
* **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
* **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:


	+ **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
	+ **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
* **Health \& wellness** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US**: Multiple low\-premium, low\-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no\-cost premium HDHP option with a pre\-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
* **Future planning** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
* **Financial security** –


	+ **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
	+ **US:** Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
* **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
* **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
* **Remote\-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off\-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
* **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
* **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
* *Country\-specific details are provided in your contract.*

title: Senior Concept Artist
description:

The role focuses on projects inspired by the visual standards of Disney Speedstorm and Asphalt 9\.

**Where this role can take you**

 **Qualifications** **WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in concept art or a related discipline, supported by a strong portfolio
* Advanced proficiency in Photoshop for digital art creation and proficiency with Blender or similar 3D software for concept development.
* Solid ability to produce clear and efficient sketches and develop concepts for characters, environments, and props.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating closely with artists, designers, and production teams

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are comfortable developing ideas and adapting them based on feedback.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different team members.

* Permanent contract, full\-time job with excellent Social Benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year
* Private medical health insurance
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card

**Benefits**

* Flexible work from home hybrid model
* Free language courses
* Birthday day off!
* 1 month of remote work
* Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career\-development opportunities.
* Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona).
* ... and Thursday afterwork beers!

 **Apply now !**

description:

This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

This isn't just a procurement role; it is a strategic position requiring a deep understanding of the global electronics ecosystem. You will be responsible for navigating the complexities of semiconductor cycles, managing relationships with top\-tier manufacturers, and identifying technical opportunities within our designs to optimize the supply chain.


You will report directly to the Purchasing Director and work as a bridge between Engineering and the global market to ensure our motorcycles remain at the cutting edge of electric performance.

* **Commercial Ownership:** Manage RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs; negotiate Master Purchase Agreements that protect Stark’s agility in a volatile market.
* **Cost \& Inventory Control:** Drive aggressive cost\-reduction activities and "total cost of ownership" models without compromising the technical integrity of our assemblies.
* **Cross\-Functional Engineering Support:** Act as a technical consultant to the Engineering team during the design phase to ensure "design\-for\-availability."

#### **What you will bring to Stark**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of senior sourcing experience, specifically focused on **Electronic Components and** **assemblies.**
* **Education:** **Electronics Engineer** (highly valuable) or a technical degree with significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* **Global Landscape Expertise:** Deep knowledge of the global semiconductor players (Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, Analog Devices, Rohm, Infineon, Murata, etc.) and the wider distribution network.
* **Technical Discernment:** The ability to read a schematic or BOM and detect opportunities for supplier diversification or technical optimization.
* **Negotiation Prowess:** A skilled negotiator who understands the nuances of the electronics industry, from NRE costs to volume rebates and buffer stock agreements.
* **Mindset:** Results\-oriented, highly analytical, and passionate about sustainability.
* **Communication:** Fluent in English (must) and Spanish (highly desired).

#### **Why work with us?**

* The chance to work on a product people are genuinely passionate about
* A fast\-growing company with real momentum
* A creative, international team based in Barcelona
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Direct access to riders, race teams, and the product — this is not a remote\-from\-the\-product role

**At Stark, we don’t just accept difference—we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.**

AstraZeneca is a global, science\-led, patient\-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. We are more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

* Provide clinical/scientific input into design \& implementation of clinical trial(s), including studies involving immunotherapy and cell therapy approaches, their delivery, clinical data review and data cleaning, interpretation of results, reporting successfully on time, and activities required for worldwide registration of the product (i.e. clinical input to NDA/BLA).

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

title: Founding SDR (DACH market)
description:
#### **About The Role**


Vivid Money is redefining how modern businesses, growing SMEs, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From high\-yield Interest Accounts and multi\-currency infrastructure to treasury tools and team cards, we provide the modern financial platform that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.


We are expanding our business presence across Germany.


We aren’t looking for an SDR to just follow a pre\-written playbook; we are looking for our **Founding SDR** for the **DACH market.** Working directly alongside our Founding Account Executive, you will be employee number one on the SDR side, responsible for building the outbound engine from scratch. Your core focus will be opening doors with SMB decision\-makers (CEOs, CFOs, Finance Directors), while strategically mapping and testing outreach to adjacent personas like holding structures, PE/VC portfolio leads, and family offices.


If you want the autonomy of a founding team member, want to write the prospecting playbook, and want to establish the top\-of\-funnel blueprint for Vivid in Germany, this role is for you.

#### **Your Mission**

* **Build the Outbound Engine:** Architect, build, and test our cold outreach sequences across phone, email, and LinkedIn targeting SMB decision\-makers across Germany.
* **Map \& Test New Personas:** Experiment with outreach strategies for secondary personas, including holding companies, VC/PE portfolio managers, and corporate service providers, to help define our expanded ICP.
* **Generate High\-Volume Pipeline:** Own top\-of\-funnel growth by sourcing, qualifying, and booking high\-intent discovery meetings for the Founding Account Executive.
* **Design the Playbook:** Partner directly with Sales Leadership to document what works, establishing the framework, templates, and best practices for future SDR hires.
* **Leverage AI \& Sales Infrastructure:** Help select, implement, and optimize our AI\-native prospecting stack, utilizing AI tools to automate research, trigger tracking, and hyper\-personalized messaging.
* **Continuous Feedback Loop:** Gather market feedback from prospect interactions to help refine product positioning, objections handling, and GTM messaging.

#### **Your Profile**

* **1–3 years of outbound prospecting experience** (SDR/BDR) in B2B FinTech, SaaS, or financial services, preferably within the DACH market.
* **Founding/Builder mindset:** High agency, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating processes from scratch rather than just executing existing ones.
* **Persona curiosity:** Ability to speak the language of SMB founders and CFOs, with a strong interest in learning how different corporate entities and treasury setups operate.
* **Tech\-savvy \& AI\-native:** Active user of modern sales stacks and AI prospecting tools to maximize outreach efficiency.
* **Tenacious \& resilient:** Motivated by raw pipeline creation, testing new angles, and iterating quickly based on response data.
* **Languages:** Full professional fluency in German and English is required.

#### **Why Join Vivid?**

* Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Barcelona office or fully remote from other locations.
* Direct influence on go\-to\-market strategy and revenue growth.
* Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities.
* AI\-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
* Learning \& development budget to support your professional growth.
* Fully paid vacation and sick leave.
* Sports compensation.
* Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.

#### **Compensation range**


Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender\-neutral criteria.

#### **About Vivid**


At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi\-IBAN accounts, high\-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150\+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.  

  

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.  

  

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.  

  

We're building Vivid as an AI\-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day\-to\-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high\-impact decision\-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI\-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

* We are your **Energy Technology Partner**. We electrify, automate, and digitalize every industry, business, and home, driving efficiency and sustainability for all.

  

At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.

  

Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?


If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!

 **Schneider Digital** is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.

  

Schneider Electric is a Fortune 500 global enterprise operating a product\-oriented infrastructure model structured around technical pillars (Network, Compute \& Storage, Cloud, Automation, Monitoring) and supported by a broad ecosystem of strategic vendors. This model enables specialization and execution at scale, but also creates fragmentation risks across prioritization, standards, financial control, vendor management, and service performance.

  

To address these risks, the Global Infrastructure Service Delivery (GISD) is establishing a Transversal Governance Team whose mission is to govern, assure, standardize, prioritize, and escalate — not to become a second operations organization or a reporting factory. Governance defines direction and control; pillars retain delivery ownership.


The ITSM \& Vendor Management Specialist is a hybrid, high\-impact role that bridges service performance (ITSM) discipline with strategic vendor oversight. The role ensures enterprise\-first outcomes, actionable transparency, and effective cross\-functional integration with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Enterprise Architecture, and the GTS PMO.

  

While this role combines responsibilities across both ITSM and Vendor Management, we are not seeking a deep subject matter expert in every area. We are looking for a professional with solid experience in one or both disciplines, strong learning agility, adaptability to change, and a willingness to grow alongside a newly established Governance Team.

This is a governance\-focused position rather than a hands\-on infrastructure operations role. The successful candidate will influence outcomes through collaboration, service governance, performance management, and stakeholder engagement across multiple technical pillars. **What will you do?**

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **A. ITSM / Service Performance, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**

* Own and publish the consolidated Infrastructure KPI / SLA Dashboard and monthly Infrastructure Availability \& Reliability Report (uptime, MTTR, MTBF, unplanned downtime), ensuring data quality, actionable insights, and timely reporting across all pillars. Maintain the Major Incident \& Post\-Mortem Register (P1/P2\), driving root\-cause analysis governance and preventive\-action follow\-through.
* Enforce observability and ITSM process standards (incident, problem, change, request, knowledge) across ServiceNow.
* Drive Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, tracking benefit realization and presenting outcomes to leadership.
* Govern aggregate service health; partner with pillar operations teams which remain accountable for instrumenting their domains.

**B. Vendor \& Contract Management**

* Produce Vendor Performance Scorecards and coordinate Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (BRs) for strategic vendors, assessing SLA attainment, delivery quality, responsiveness, strategic alignment, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Act as the single point of governance for assigned strategic vendor relationships, fostering executive engagement while surfacing risks, issues, and opportunities to Infrastructure leadership.
* Operate the SLA Breach \& Remediation Tracker, driving vendor accountability, corrective\-action plans, penalty/credit follow\-up, and escalation of material service issues.
* Support RFPs, sourcing events, contract negotiations, and renewal planning in partnership with Procurement and Legal, ensuring auditable sourcing decisions and preventing unfavorable auto\-renewals.
* Identify vendor consolidation, optimization, and cost\-efficiency opportunities across the supplier portfolio, supporting financial, operational, and strategic objectives.

**What qualifications will make you successful for this role?**

 **Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related discipline.
* 6–8\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, governance, service management, vendor management, or related technology functions, including exposure to ITSM and/or vendor governance activities.
* Proven ability to collaborate across complex organizations, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and build alignment across cross\-functional teams.
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification required.
* Hands\-on expertise with ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, modules).

 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy access to wellness content, nutrition counseling, fitness classes, and more!


‍From dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer an agreement with Wellhub so you can access a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers to keep your body active in the way you like best.


 Your well\-being is our priority. You will have medical service at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.

  

We empower you:


 With Career Hub, our AI\-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.


 We offer you the opportunity to be a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements with our stock ownership program.


 We celebrate everyone's talent and success with our recognition program, through which you can give and receive points for your achievements and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.


 You will have life insurance for your protection.


 We offer you a Flexible Remuneration Plan in which you can choose from a variety of options, such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.


 With Club Schneider, you will enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.


 Participate in company\-subsidized volunteer programs to contribute to our community and have a positive impact on your environment.

  

Let us know about you, apply today!

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.


We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.


Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled. *Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best.
