Our expertise spans cloud, data, AI/ML, embedded software, IoT, and more, driving digital transformation across finance, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and other industries. Join N\-iX and become part of a team where your ideas make a real impact.


**About the Role**



Our customer is a leading European online car marketplace, serving more than 30 million monthly users across 18 countries.



They are launching a company\-wide initiative to embed AI and agentic ways of working into Product and User Experience. We are looking for a senior, hands\-on Technical Product Manager to help define, pilot and scale an AI\-enabled product\-development methodology across approximately 100 Product and UX professionals in Europe and Canada.



This is an individual contributor role for someone with strong product judgement, practical AI adoption experience and enough technical fluency to turn AI capabilities into repeatable, valuable ways of working. The focus is not on introducing isolated tools or use cases, but on transforming how Product, UX and Engineering teams collaborate throughout the product\-development lifecycle.



This position is available on a part\-time basis with flexible working hours (20\+ hours per week)


**What You Will Do:**


* Define and champion a clear vision for an AI\-enabled Product and UX organization, translating it into a pragmatic, staged transformation plan.
* Design, test and roll out AI\-enabled and agentic workflows across the product lifecycle — from discovery and requirements definition to prototyping, experimentation and delivery.
* Establish practical workflows in which Product Managers use tools such as GitHub, Codex or comparable AI\-assisted tools to create and improve product requirements, while UX teams use these outputs to accelerate low\-fidelity prototypes.
* Partner with cross\-functional pilot teams to identify high\-value use cases, test and refine new ways of working, and validate their value through iterative delivery.
* Turn proven approaches into scalable playbooks, templates, governance and enablement materials that teams can adopt independently.
* Assess AI tools, workflows and adoption barriers pragmatically, with a focus on business value, quality, usability and responsible implementation.
* Align Product, UX, Engineering and senior leadership around priorities, decisions, progress, risks and next steps.
* Structure, coordinate and track multiple transformation workstreams; measure adoption and impact, using feedback and data to continuously improve the methodology.
* Provide strategic direction while remaining hands\-on in the day\-to\-day delivery of the transformation.


**Must Have:**


* Significant experience as a Technical Product Manager, Product Lead, Product Operations leader or in a similar product\-facing transformation role.
* Strong product background and credibility with Product leadership; ability to connect customer and business value with technical possibilities and make sound prioritization decisions.
* Demonstrable experience driving AI adoption, change management, product operating\-model transformation or internal enablement across multiple teams.
* Hands\-on experience applying generative AI, LLM\-based tools, copilots or workflow automation in a product\-development setting.
* Practical familiarity with GitHub, Codex, GitHub Copilot or comparable AI\-assisted development and product tools, including the ability to identify and implement valuable use cases for Product and UX teams.
* Good understanding of agentic ways of working and how AI can reshape roles, workflows and the product\-development lifecycle.
* Experience designing, piloting and scaling processes, operating models or ways of working across Product, UX/Design and Engineering teams.
* Strong program execution skills: able to structure, coordinate, track and report progress across multiple workstreams while maintaining momentum.
* Sufficient technical fluency to collaborate effectively with Engineering and understand APIs, software\-delivery workflows, data and limitations of AI tools. Coding expertise is not required.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written and spoken English communication skills.
* Comfortable operating under ambiguity and influencing senior Product and Technology stakeholders.


**Nice to Have:**


* Experience in a marketplace, e\-commerce, classifieds, consumer\-facing or high\-growth environment.
* Experience scaling AI practices across distributed, multi\-country organizations.
* Experience helping Product and UX teams improve discovery, requirements definition, prototyping or experimentation.


**What Success Looks Like After Six Months:**


* Pilot teams are using AI meaningfully in Product and UX workflows.
* A practical AI\-enabled product\-development methodology is documented, tested and ready to scale.
* Product requirements and early UX prototypes are produced faster and with greater consistency.
* Teams have the playbooks, tools and confidence to adopt the approach independently.
* Leadership has clear visibility into adoption, impact, risks and next steps.

**We offer\*:**


* Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location\-specific benefits


* not applicable for freelancers

description:
The Opportunity
UserWise is looking for an experienced **Lead UI/UX Designer** to own the UI/UX discipline for a a mobile Free\-to\-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.


This is a **hands\-on leadership role** for someone who can translate game and product designs into clear flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes before significant art or engineering work begins. You will stay ahead of production, validate interactions early, identify usability problems before they become expensive production problems, and follow features through implementation to ensure the intended player experience survives into the final game.


You will also mentor and work alongside an existing UI/UX Designer, helping establish stronger UX processes, patterns, and quality standards across the project.


This is not a management\-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.


What You’ll Do* Own the overall **UX quality and UI/UX discipline** across the game.
* Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.
* Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.
* Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.
* Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.
* Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.
* Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.
* Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.
* Improve the **Game Design**  **UX**  **Art**  **Engineering** workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late\-stage redesigns.
* Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.
* Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.
* Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.

  

**Requirements**  

  

What We’re Looking For* Senior or Lead\-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.
* Strong shipped experience with **mobile Free\-to\-Play games**, ideally casual or mass\-market titles.
* A portfolio demonstrating both **UX thinking and finished game experiences**, not just polished UI screens.
* Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.
* Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.
* Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.
* Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.
* Strong proficiency with **Figma** or equivalent modern product\-design tools.
* Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low\-fidelity UX when needed.
* Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.
* Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.
* Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.
* Familiarity with Unity\-based game production is highly valuable.
* Comfort using AI\-assisted or rapid\-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.


Portfolio
A strong portfolio is essential for this role.


We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:

* Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences
* User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
* Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI
* Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX
* Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem
* Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team


Case studies showing **how you arrived at a solution** are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

 **Benefits**  

  

Why Join UserWise* Own the UX of a flagship mobile game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.
* Have significant influence over the product while it is still actively being shaped.
* Work in a lean team where UI/UX is central to the game experience rather than a downstream production function.
* Establish the UX processes, standards, and design systems that guide the project.
* Experiment with rapid prototyping and AI\-assisted workflows to increase iteration speed and design quality.
* 100% remote, flexible work with a small, experienced team.


What We Offer* Market\-competitive compensation
* Paid Time Off
* Performance Bonus
* Annual Performance Reviews

**Role Overview**


A senior engineering leadership role responsible for the technical direction, hands\-on delivery, and production scaling of AI solutions across enterprise enabling functions — including **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, Compliance, and Business Development**.


This is a **builder\-leader role**. The Engineering Director combines deep hands\-on AI engineering — designing and shipping multi\-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and governed AI applications — with the technical leadership required to drive a team from opportunity identification through to production deployment. They bring a rare and deliberate combination: the ability to move from idea to working proof\-of\-concept in days, alongside significant depth in **AI governance**, **operational resilience**, and **regulatory compliance** — not as adjacent knowledge, but as a core professional discipline that shapes how they build, assess, and operate AI systems.


The role sits within the Enterprise AI function and works in close partnership with enterprise technology, data engineering, technology governance, legal, information security, and functional stakeholders to deliver AI that is **production\-grade, auditable, and compliant from the first commit** — not retrofitted at the end. Given geographic considerations, the role carries particular responsibility for navigating multi\-jurisdictional data sovereignty, regulatory divergence, and cross\-border AI governance — ensuring systems are defensible under all applicable regulatory regimes.


**Context**


Enabling functions — HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance — govern how an organisation hires, contracts, spends, reports, partners, audits, and maintains compliance. They represent **high\-value AI opportunities** and **high\-consequence environments** — where outputs carry regulatory, financial, and reputational weight. Realising value at scale requires engineering leadership that can navigate complex data landscapes, build for reuse, and embed governance, human oversight, and operational resilience into architecture decisions from the outset.


These AI applications do not exist in a vacuum. Each system must be governed — classified, registered, monitored, auditable, and defensible to regulators, auditors, and internal oversight functions. The governance and resilience challenge is twofold: building AI systems that are *themselves* resilient and well\-governed, and ensuring the frameworks, processes, and controls that surround those systems are robust, proportionate, and continuously maintained. The role demands someone who has operated at this intersection for a significant portion of their career — not someone encountering governance as a new discipline.


This role is designed for an engineer who has already built AI applications inside a **large, regulated enterprise**, who has **demonstrated experience delivering AI solutions across multiple enabling functions** (e.g., HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit), who has significant experience governing AI systems and embedding operational resilience disciplines around them, and who treats regulatory requirements as **architecture decisions** — not compliance checkboxes.


**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Technical Direction \& Architecture**


* Lead the engineering roadmap for AI across enabling functions, aligning architecture, delivery sequencing, and capability development to business priorities across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance**
* Set architectural direction for scalable, governed AI platforms — designing for **modularity**, **cross\-functional reuse**, and **compliance from the outset**
* Make high\-consequence technical decisions on architecture, build\-vs\-buy, model strategy (foundation models, fine\-tuning, multi\-provider orchestration, RAG), and integration patterns
* Drive **platform thinking over project thinking** — building shared components, reusable agent patterns, and common governance instrumentation that accelerate delivery across the portfolio
* Ensure architecture accounts for data sovereignty requirements — model routing, data residency, and hosting decisions that respect jurisdictional boundaries and cross\-border transfer requirements
* Shape investment cases for senior stakeholders, articulating engineering decisions in terms of scalability, risk, regulatory defensibility, and value creation

**2\. Hands\-On AI Engineering \& Delivery**


* Design and ship **multi\-agent LLM architectures** across multiple model providers, choosing models against product requirements and compliance constraints — including sovereignty\-aware routing through region\-specific infrastructure where required
* Build **RAG pipelines** over real enterprise corpora with named single\-purpose agents, hallucination guards before any user\-facing output, and immutable audit logging at every stage
* Use AI\-assisted development tooling to compress delivery from months to days, while keeping architecture decisions, model routing, and guardrails under deliberate human control
* Lead technical design for complex solutions spanning enabling functions — **HR policy automation, contract risk scoring, procurement analytics, compliance monitoring, financial forecasting, audit analytics, and document intelligence** — with governance built in from the first build
* Ensure rapid experimentation capability with clear engineering gates between proof\-of\-concept, pilot, and production — measuring against real data and real success criteria, not mock demos

**3\. AI Governance \& Regulatory Compliance**


*This is a defining pillar of the role.* The organisation requires an engineering leader with significant, demonstrated experience in AI governance — someone who has designed governance frameworks, built governance tooling, and operated in governance roles — not simply complied with governance requirements set by others.


* **Governance architecture**: Design and operate the governance structures that surround AI applications — classification and tiering, risk assessment, model registration, approval workflows, ongoing monitoring obligations, and decommissioning criteria
* **Regulatory compliance (multi\-jurisdictional)**: Ensure systems meet requirements under applicable data protection laws, AI\-specific regulations (e.g., EU AI Act risk classification, emerging national AI frameworks), and sector\-specific operational resilience expectations — navigating divergence and maintaining defensibility under multiple regimes
* **Data sovereignty**: Design data\-residency and model\-routing approaches that respect adequacy arrangements, data\-transfer mechanisms, and sovereignty constraints — ensuring processing is appropriately separated by jurisdiction where required, with sovereign model options (e.g., region\-specific cloud deployments, local model hosting)
* **Responsible agentic architecture**: Design systems where AI agents reason autonomously but consequential action is human\-gated — with every decision writing an audit row recording what model decided what, on what evidence
* **Governance\-by\-design**: Embed deterministic classification/routing layers, human\-in\-the\-loop oversight, model/data cards, and full audit trails into standard engineering practice — treating these as first\-class architecture components, not afterthoughts
* **Second\-line posture**: Ensure governance tooling supports independent review — maintaining separation between the teams that build and the functions that assess, with tool design reflecting this control
* **Domain\-specific requirements**: Ensure AI systems handling financially material data (Finance), legally privileged documents (Legal), employee\-sensitive information (HR), supplier\-confidential data (Procurement), or audit evidence (Audit) meet the specific governance and evidential standards those domains require (e.g., SOX, legal privilege, chain\-of\-custody, employment law)
* **Lifecycle governance**: Own the ongoing governance obligations for live AI systems — periodic re\-assessment, performance review against stated tolerances, change\-impact assessment, and documented decision trails for model updates or retirement

**4\. Operational Resilience — For AI Systems**


*The second defining pillar.* The role requires significant experience in operational resilience as a discipline — not just awareness, but hands\-on engineering delivery.


* Engineer operational resilience into AI applications — circuit breakers, provider fallbacks, graceful degradation, fail\-safe defaults, and dependency\-aware architecture so essential functions survive outages
* **Design for failure**: assume model providers, data sources, and integration points will fail, and ensure user\-facing services degrade safely rather than catastrophically
* Ensure AI systems are mapped against the organisation's important business services framework — with defined impact tolerances, recovery objectives, and tested failover paths

**5\. Engineering Leadership \& Team Development**


* Lead a multi\-disciplinary engineering team comprising software, ML, data, and platform engineers — recruiting, developing, and retaining strong technical talent
* Set engineering culture and standards for **code quality**, **testing**, **documentation**, **peer review**, and **production readiness**
* Develop senior technical contributors and engineering leads — building depth and succession within the team
* Mentor and enable non\-technical colleagues across enabling functions to ship their own AI applications, building AI literacy across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance**
* Manage capacity and team topology — making deliberate choices about structure, specialisation, and balance across discovery, delivery, and sustainment

**6\. Delivery \& Production Excellence**


* Drive end\-to\-end engineering delivery from architecture through to production deployment, scaling, monitoring, and lifecycle management
* Partner with enterprise technology teams to leverage shared platforms, infrastructure, and services — ensuring solutions are built on common foundations and contribute back to enterprise capability
* Establish and enforce standards for model serving, data pipelines, API design, integration patterns, security, and observability
* Drive **MLOps maturity** including CI/CD, automated testing, performance monitoring, incident management, and capacity planning
* Own the data engineering approach for AI across enabling functions — pipelines, feature stores, and data products designed for quality, governance, and reuse
* Establish data quality, lineage, and governance standards appropriate for financially material data, legally privileged documents, employee PII, and personally identifiable information subject to applicable data protection laws

**7\. Model Quality, Drift \& Assurance**


* Establish **model\-drift and bias monitoring** across the portfolio — measuring divergence across runs and generating targeted refinement recommendations
* Design and operate AI red\-team capability to probe and refine model outputs before release and on an ongoing basis
* Build automated fairness testing, explainability pipelines, and decision audit trails embedded in standard workflows
* Own technical risk management across the portfolio including model degradation, data quality drift, dependency risk, and integration risk
* Ensure model assurance reporting meets the expectations of internal audit, technology governance, and external regulators

**8\. Scaling Through Partnership**


* Work in close partnership with enterprise technology to align on shared infrastructure, platform services, tooling, and engineering standards
* Identify and scale opportunities across enabling functions — recognising where a solution proven in one function (e.g., contract intelligence in Legal) can be adapted and deployed in another (e.g., supplier risk in Procurement)
* Engage external technology partners strategically — co\-developing or integrating capabilities where they accelerate delivery or provide specialist functionality
* Shape joint programmes with partners, defining technical scope, integration architecture, and quality standards — ensuring partnerships deliver production\-grade outcomes
* Build a **scaling model** that leverages shared services, external partners, and cross\-functional reuse to multiply impact without proportional headcount growth

**9\. Stakeholder Partnership \& Adoption**


* Serve as a credible technical partner to functional leaders across **HR, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Audit, and Compliance** — providing counsel on AI opportunity, risk, regulatory posture, and investment
* Work as an **internal consultant**: run discovery with each business unit, surface real problems, frame concrete use cases with measurable success criteria, and drive adoption through continuous UX iteration and direct user\-feedback loops
* Translate between engineering complexity and business strategy — communicating trade\-offs, timelines, and constraints so leaders can make informed decisions
* Measure success by **real adoption and operational impact**, not by demonstrations — building KPI/KRI frameworks giving leaders visibility into usage, quality, and value

**10\. Enterprise AI Integration**


* Represent enabling functions within enterprise AI leadership forums and architecture governance, ensuring alignment on standards, platform strategy, and shared services
* Contribute to enterprise AI governance including architecture review boards, AI policy development, and standards evolution
* Drive reuse and knowledge sharing — identifying where governance and resilience patterns developed for enabling functions can accelerate delivery elsewhere
* Advocate for enabling function requirements within the broader enterprise technology agenda, ensuring platform priorities reflect the needs of regulated, process\-critical functions

Evinova is seeking an entrepreneurial, AI\-fluent Product Director to take ownership of a core product area, building it from the ground up with AI at its foundation. As Product Director, you will operate with significant autonomy and act as the general manager for your product area at Evinova. You will identify whitespace, validate opportunities directly with end users and customers, ship V1 products, and iterate relentlessly—embedding AI and machine learning into every layer of the product build, maintenance, and experience, and driving connectivity across Evinova’s modules so workflows flow seamlessly for clinical development and clinical operations teams. This role requires a builder who thrives in ambiguity and brings the conviction to create something new within a world\-class life sciences software organization.


**WHAT YOU’LL DO**


**Build an AI\-Native Product from Zero to One**


* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for an AI\-native product, from first principles through scale.
* Develop a deep, first\-hand understanding of our users, their problem spaces, and their day\-to\-day workflows—pinpointing where the product can deliver step\-function impact rather than incremental gains.
* Drive rapid hypothesis validation through prototyping and experimentation.
* Own the full product lifecycle end\-to\-end: from concept and design through development, launch, go\-to\-market, and post\-launch iteration informed by usage data and customer feedback.

**Lead AI\-Native Product Development**


* Architect the product with AI and machine learning at its core—for example: intelligent automation, contextual recommendations, predictive insights, and generative AI–powered workflows that reduce effort for end users.
* Collaborate closely with data science and engineering teams to translate cutting\-edge AI capabilities into practical, regulation\-aware product features.
* Design for the end user first—building intuitive, collaborative workflows that reduce burden and enable clinical development and clinical operations teams to work seamlessly together, with connectivity across Evinova’s modules.
* Meet users where they are and guide them through their change management journey—earning adoption by easing the transition to new, AI\-enabled ways of working rather than forcing it.
* Maintain a sharp point of view on the evolving clinical trial and AI landscape—proactively identifying opportunities to apply emerging capabilities to the challenges faced by clinical development and clinical operations teams.

**Drive Strategic Leadership Across Evinova**


* Partner with a matrixed product organization to drive connectivity across Evinova’s modules and inform the product roadmap. Partner with commercial to ensure the product does not over\-fit to any one customer. Iterate relentlessly in pursuit of product\-market fit.
* Serve as the strategic product leader across the organization, aligning engineering, design, data science, and commercial around a unified product vision.
* Communicate product strategy, progress, and trade\-offs to Evinova’s executive leadership and key enterprise customers.
* Define and own success metrics—adoption, engagement, revenue contribution, clinical trial cycle\-time reduction—and drive data\-informed prioritization.

**Operate with Entrepreneurial Ownership**


* Treat your product area as your own business—own the P\&L mindset, make resource trade\-offs, and drive measurable commercial outcomes.
* Navigate the tension between speed\-to\-market and regulatory compliance (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Cultivate strategic partnerships with data providers and standards bodies (CDISC, HL7 FHIR) to accelerate Evinova’s product capabilities.
* Champion a culture of experimentation, intellectual honesty, and continuous learning within your product area and across the broader Evinova team.

**WHAT YOU BRING**


**Required Experience**


* 8\+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a director\-level or senior product leadership capacity owning a product area end\-to\-end.
* Domain experience in clinical trials or life sciences. You bring a deep understanding of the clinical development and clinical operations personas, know the clinical ecosystem (EDC, CDMS, CTMS, eTMF), and can engage credibly with clinical operations leaders, medical directors, biostatisticians, data managers, and regulatory professionals.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial track record: you have taken at least one product from zero to one—as a founder, early\-stage PM, or intrapreneur within a larger organization. You can point to products you conceived, shipped, and scaled.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI/ML\-powered products. You understand model development lifecycles, training data strategies, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and the unique UX challenges of AI\-driven features. AI fluency is non\-negotiable for this role.
* Proven ability to operate in enterprise B2B SaaS environments, including navigating complex stakeholder landscapes, long sales cycles, and platform\-level product decisions.
* Strong technical acumen: comfortable partnering directly with engineers and data scientists, reviewing technical specifications, and contributing to architectural trade\-off decisions.

**At** **Lexroom** **we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.**


In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by **thousands of legal professionals across Europe**.


Our mission is clear: **make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable**, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.


We’re scaling rapidly, backed by top\-tier investors and a world\-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and impact.


Today, Lexroom is a **trusted partner**, shaping the future of legal AI with discipline and purpose.

  

**Why** **Lexroom****?**
------------------------

* **Shape the Standard:** Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
* **Work with the Best:** Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.
* **Deliver Meaningful Results:** Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.


At **Lexroom**, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: **a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.**

  

**Role**
--------

**Lexroom** is building its partnership channel from close to zero and wants it to become a material driver of revenue growth. You will own that channel end to end: strategic reselling and co\-sell relationships with big consulting firms and system integrators, large enterprise accounts, and early\-stage product partnerships as our API surface develops. You will define the operating model, prove it in market, and build the team that scales it across our European footprint.


This is a build\-from\-scratch leadership seat reporting directly to our CRO and co\-founder, not a role inheriting an established motion.

**Your key responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* **Channel design and ownership**: design the partnership channel and build it into a material revenue driver, owning co\-sell and revenue\-share relationships end to end.
* **Operating model**: define whether and how partnership closes its own revenue versus feeds the sales pipeline, and build the case, grounded in data, for the model you back.
* **Relationship ownership**: personally run Lexroom's most valuable strategic relationships, from prospecting through signature.
* **Playbook design**: build repeatable processes for partner sourcing, qualification, engagement rules, and co\-sell motion from the ground up.
* **Team building**: hire and lead country partnership leads and associates as deal volume justifies.
* **Partner enablement and certification**: build training, certification, and co\-marketing materials that let partners sell and implement independently over time.
* **Tooling and attribution**: define the partner\-source model in the CRM, own the deal registration policy, and track partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline with the discipline of a revenue function, not a marketing one.
* **Performance management and partner reviews**: define KPIs (pipeline generated, ARR sourced or influenced, logos activated), build dashboards, and run structured quarterly business reviews with strategic partners.
* **Cross\-functional alignment**: agree lead handoff and attribution rules with Sales leaders, work with Finance and Legal on commission and revenue\-share structures, and scope product\-partnership opportunities with Product.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Partnership leadership track record**: 7\+ years in business development, alliances, or channel roles in B2B SaaS, including at least 3 years owning revenue\-accountable relationships with system integrators or consulting partners in an enterprise or mid\-market context. Ideally you have built a partnership motion from an early stage rather than inherited one at scale.
* **Complex deal negotiation**: the commercial rigour to structure and close revenue\-share and co\-sell agreements with Big 4 firms and system integrators, including multi\-stakeholder, long\-cycle negotiations. Familiarity with frameworks such as MEDDICC or Challenger Sale is a plus.
* **Builder mindset, not a maintainer**: comfortable building playbooks, attribution models, and team rituals from scratch in a function where most of the infrastructure does not exist yet.
* **International experience**: you have built or managed partnership relationships across multiple European markets. You know a playbook that works in one country rarely transfers unchanged, and you adjust commercial terms and positioning accordingly.
* **Commercial and analytical judgment**: able to structure and negotiate commission and revenue\-share terms, build pipeline and ARR forecasting for partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced deals, and make prioritisation calls on which partners and deals to pursue, grounded in data.
* **Languages**: fluent English is required, plus professional fluency in at least one of Italian, French, Spanish, or German. Additional European languages are a plus.

**Rewarding your contribution**
-------------------------------

* **Compensation (Milan equivalent)**: €120,000–160,000 OTE
* **Equity**: meaningful equity on top, in line with the seniority of the role
* **Team retreats \& off\-sites**: dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas

 **At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose.**


We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.


Compensation Range: €120K \- €160K

Backed by EBRD and trusted by 1000\+ companies across 150\+ countries, RemotePass is the platform that gives businesses the infrastructure to hire anyone, anywhere \- and gives workers in emerging markets the financial tools and global access they deserve.


RemotePass is the only platform that combines Employer of Record, contractor management, direct employment, and corporate spend cards in a single product \- rated 4\.8/5 on G2, trusted by Spotify, Logitech, and Deloitte, and operating across 150\+ countries.


We are backed by leading global investors, including Oraseya Capital, Endeavor Catalyst, Khwarizmi Ventures, Flyer One Ventures, Access Bridge Ventures, A15, Swiss Founders Fund,

**About the Role:**


We are a rapidly growing company that specializes in providing comprehensive global HR and payroll solutions for businesses. Partnerships are set to become one of our largest sources of new pipeline over the next three years, and we are building that function now.


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated individual to build that channel for RemotePass, deciding which partner types are worth pursuing, recruiting and signing them, and making sure the pipeline they produce is measurable and converting.

* Establish roadmap priorities and quarterly focuses for the channel, and report on them monthly with the same rigour as a sales forecast.
* Design and deliver onboarding and enablement for new partners, so they understand our proposition and can position us accurately.
* Nurture existing partner relationships so that RemotePass is the provider they think of first, and so referral volume grows over time.
* Work with our go\-to\-market engineer to make partner\-sourced pipeline properly traceable in our CRM, so channel contribution can be measured and defended.
* Co\-sell with our account executives, bringing partners into live opportunities and owning the handoffs in both directions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Marketing, Sales, Product and Operations, to align channel goals with wider company objectives.
* Monitor and analyse channel performance, identify what is not working, and act on it.
* Act as the main point of contact for our partners, responding to enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and competitor channel programmes, and make recommendations accordingly.
* Prepare regular reports and presentations on channel performance for management and key stakeholders.

  

**Requirements**  

* + 4 to 7 years of experience in B2B SaaS or professional services, with at least 2 in channel, partnerships, alliances or partner\-led business development.
	+ A current or recent role that is hands\-on.
	+ Evidence of building rather than maintaining.
	+ Comfort with outbound partner recruitment.
	+ An understanding of how partner contribution is measured, and a view on how it should be
	+ Strong understanding of partner acquisition and engagement strategies.
	+ Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to build credibility with senior people at professional services firms, where the person across the table is an adviser rather than a buyer.
	+ Proficient in data analysis and metrics reporting.
	+ Strong organisational and project management skills, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.
	+ Familiarity with CRM systems, ideally HubSpot

  

**Benefits**  

* Be part of a fast\-growing global company revolutionizing remote work management.
* Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment that values innovation and creativity.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Competitive, uncapped variable compensation tied directly to the accounts you grow.

title: People Systems & Automation Engineer
description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people \- helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.


What started in Poland is now an international, cloud\-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.


For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.


Working in a rapidly growing, ever\-changing scale\-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.  

  

**The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:**  

As an People System \& Automation Engineer reporting to the Head of People Technology, your purpose will be to build the automations that free our People \& Culture teams from admin and to own them end to end.

* Build integrations and workflows against live systems: BigQuery, Google Cloud, Apps Script, and our HR and hiring platform APIs
* Put Claude and Gemini into production workflows, with guardrails and a human checkpoint wherever judgement is needed
* Design configurable engines rather than one\-off scripts — you'll be the one maintaining them
* Work with process owners across People \& Culture to turn what they actually do into something buildable
* Track the hours and cost your work frees up, and report it


We've mapped over 200 processes. The principle behind every build: automate the admin, keep the judgement human. You'll be levelled and mentored inside our Product \& Tech function, working alongside our existing engineer.

 **Requirements** **Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…**

* Strong BigQuery and SQL skills you'll be tested on this early in the process
* Expert\-level workflow automation: multi\-step scenarios, branching, data stores, error handling and webhooks
* Practical experience putting LLMs into production with structured outputs, guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Discretion with sensitive data — pay, performance and candidate information, handled in line with GDPR
* At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business\-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

**It will also help you to have…**

* Working code ability — JavaScript (Google Apps Script) and/or Python for the glue no\-code can't reach
* Google Cloud experience (Firebase, AI Studio)
* Experience taking a non\-technical team through a change in how they work, not just shipping the tool

  

**Benefits**  

We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote\-first.


Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote \- either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.


Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.  

  

**How AI helps us find great people**


Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role \- but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application \- it won't affect your chances in any way.

**Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:**


We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at belonging@booksy.com, so we can best support you.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

title: Engineering Director - Platform
description:
We are looking for an Engineering Director to own the technology platform behind the GoMining ecosystem.


This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep engineering expertise with strong product and business thinking.


You will own the Platform end\-to\-end — technology strategy, architecture, engineering organization, roadmap, reliability, delivery, and its impact on the wider business.


The Platform powers multiple GoMining products and includes core application infrastructure, authentication and authorization, integrations, shared services, analytics infrastructure, user restrictions, native applications, reliability, and other foundational capabilities.


This is not a role where success is measured simply by uptime, delivery, or engineering output.


We expect the Engineering Director to understand where technology creates or limits business value, make trade\-offs between long\-term architecture and immediate commercial priorities, and build a platform that allows the entire company to move faster.

  


ResponsibilitiesPlatform Strategy \& Architecture* Own the technology strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GoMining Platform.
* Build scalable shared infrastructure used across multiple products and engineering teams.
* Define which capabilities should be centralized at Platform level and which should remain within individual product teams.
* Drive major architectural and technical decisions.
* Identify scalability and architectural bottlenecks before they become business\-critical.
* Balance long\-term platform investments with immediate product and commercial priorities.


Reliability \& Engineering Excellence* Own platform reliability, availability, latency, scalability, and operational performance.
* Define and improve SLAs, DORA metrics, engineering performance, and incident\-management practices.
* Improve release stability, engineering velocity, and system resilience.
* Lead post\-incident improvements and eliminate systemic reliability issues.
* Maintain a high engineering bar without unnecessary bureaucracy.


Core Platform Capabilities* Own shared authentication, authorization, registration, and 2FA infrastructure.
* Develop common account controls, user restrictions, and security mechanisms.
* Own integrations and shared backend capabilities required across GoMining products.
* Develop shared analytics and event infrastructure.
* Support common infrastructure across web and native applications.
* Partner with Product, Design, Security, and engineering teams on cross\-company capabilities.


Product \& Business Impact
Platform at GoMining is not an isolated infrastructure function.


You will work directly with product leaders, General Managers, and C\-level stakeholders to understand where technology can unlock growth and where platform limitations are holding the business back.

* Prioritize engineering initiatives based on technical risk and business impact.
* Understand how platform decisions affect revenue, conversion, customer experience, and product velocity.
* Identify technical changes that can unlock meaningful business results.
* Balance competing priorities across multiple product teams.
* Make clear trade\-offs between speed, scalability, reliability, security, and business value.
* Measure Platform not only through technical metrics, but through how effectively it accelerates the company.


Engineering Leadership* Lead and develop the Platform engineering organization.
* Own team structure, hiring, performance, priorities, and execution.
* Build a culture of strong engineering ownership and accountability.
* Stay close enough to architecture and technology to challenge decisions and make informed trade\-offs.
* Develop strong technical leaders within the team.
* Raise the technical and execution bar across the organization.


AI\-First Engineering* Actively use AI tools and agents in your own work.
* Introduce AI\-assisted workflows across engineering, specifications, QA, analytics, and operations.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work.
* Use AI to increase engineering velocity and quality.
* Build a team where AI becomes part of the engineering operating model.

  

**Requirements**  

* + - Experience as an Engineering Director, Head of Engineering, Head of Platform, VP Engineering, CTO, or in a comparable senior engineering leadership role.

title: Revenue Manager
description:

* The opportunity to work with an exciting new hospitality concept in Madrid and have a real impact on its success.

* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.

* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* High level of discretion and professionalism.
* Comfortable working with different stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.
* Experience coordinating events, projects or cross\-functional initiatives is a plus.
* Fluent English (written and spoken); French would be an advantage.
### **Additional information**

### **About us**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


If you think this role is made for you, we'd love to hear from you. Please send us your CV.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.  



At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Employer:** **DWS Group**

**Title:** **Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director**

**Location:** **Madrid**

**Job Code:** *placeholder for LinkedIn job wrapping*

**About DWS:**

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.


Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry\-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.


We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.


As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.


This is your chance to invest in your future.


Read more about DWS and who we are here.


**Team / division overview**

The role sits at the intersection of hands\-on delivery and strategic influence. You will work directly with engineers, analysts, delivery leads, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful AI use cases, build practical examples, coach teams, and remove blockers to adoption. At the same time, you will translate what is being learned on the ground into clear recommendations for leadership, tooling, governance, roadmap choices, and ways of working.


Reporting into the Head of Corporate Functions (CF) Technology, you will be embedded in the area where AI adoption needs to happen. You will also work closely with the DWS AI Centre of Excellence, ensuring that Corporate Functions is both aligned to enterprise AI direction and actively shaping it through real delivery experience. You will help create and nurture the Corporate Functions AI Community of Practice, so that knowledge, experimentation, and adoption are shared across teams rather than remaining isolated in individual pockets.


**Your responsibilities –**

As Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director, you will:


* Act as the primary AI champion embedded within the delivery and operational teams, working alongside engineers, analysts, and delivery leads to embed AI into everyday practice.
* Lead and facilitate the AI Open House and equivalent adoption programmes including curating peer wins, facilitating skill\-building segments, and visibly resolving blockers.
* Coach individuals and teams on practical AI use, from prompt engineering and gen\-AI features through to building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Serve as the primary convenor and energiser of the AI Community of Practice ensuring it has rhythm, relevance, and genuine peer ownership.
* Curate and grow a shared knowledge base of AI use cases, prompt libraries, lessons learned, and emerging tools relevant to the team.
* Design and run lightweight experimentation programmes including challenges, hackathons, discovery sprints that surface new AI applications and build confidence across teams.
* Act as the CF technology team’s primary AI thought leader and strategic advisor to leadership translating field\-level insight into strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with AI developments across the industry particularly in financial services and bring relevant intelligence into AI CoE leadership conversations and roadmap decisions.
* Advise CF business stakeholders on how AI can be applied to their specific domains, translating technical capability into business value language.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI\-powered tools, prototypes, and integrations demonstrating feasibility and sparking wider adoption through working examples.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions including RAG pipelines, LLM\-powered applications, and agentic workflows that connect AI to real business processes.
* Evaluate internal and SaaS AI models, platforms, and tooling including LLMs, agentic frameworks, and productivity tools and make grounded recommendations based on practical, production\-aware experience.

We are looking for


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience building software, with confidence working in a modern development environment and credibility with engineering teams.
* Practical, working experience with AI models and tools including LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub CoPilot or equivalent. Demonstrable delivery of at least one RAG implementation, an agentic workflow, a fine\-tuned model, or a production LLM integration.
* A genuine track record of driving AI adoption within an organization, making it happen at the team level and measuring what changed.
* Experience working in or closely with technology teams in complex organizations — ideally within financial services, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple organizational layers from coaching junior developers to briefing senior leadership
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and comfort working in a modern development environment
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tooling: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and observability approaches.
* Understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent coordination with experience designing or building systems that use them.
* Understanding of how regulated financial services organizations operate including data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and the specific risk appetite that shapes technology decisions.
* Awareness of how leading financial institutions are approaching AI adoption.
* Ability to translate AI capability into business value language relevant to financial services such as risk reduction, control improvement, cost efficiency, revenue enablement, client experience and making the case to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrably well\-read on AI developments. You follow research, read technical blogs, track model releases, and can hold a credible conversation about where the field is heading and what it means for the organisation.
* Strong understanding of change management and adoption dynamics. You know why people resist new tools and how to meet them where they are and led early interest into sustained adoption.
* Curious about the intersection of AI and organisational design \-how capability builds, how communities form, and what it takes to move an institution rather than just a team.

**What we’ll offer you:**

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work \- feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.


DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in\-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.


If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long\-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.


We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

description:
**THE RESIDENCES**


Mandarin Oriental has experienced exponential growth in the development of The Residences at Mandarin Oriental, in combination with hotels, to form complex mixed\-use and stand\-alone projects. Integral to the growth of the Mandarin Oriental footprint, Residences are a new paradigm, and as such require focused operational expertise. In addition to the goal of delivering superior experiences and services to Residences owners, Mandarin Oriental is focused not only on the management of the Residences common areas to the very high standards our guests have become accustomed, but to continually improving our relationship with Residence owners over the long term.

  

**STRATEGIC INTENT**


The mission of this position is for the incumbent to assume full responsibility for all aspects of residential services, concierge operations, and the lifestyle experience of our residents during both the pre\-opening and post\-opening phases.


The ideal candidate will be proactive, creative, and resident\-centric, with a strong focus on excellence and operational efficiency. They must consistently keep the residents’ perspective in mind when delivering services and products and always represent the brand with professionalism and integrity. This role also serves as a key development opportunity for operations\-focused professionals aspiring to advance into positions within Group Residences or Hotel operations across MOHG projects.


The incumbent is expected to demonstrate tenacity, creativity, flexibility, and unwavering commitment to ensure a successful residential launch, strategic positioning, and continued operation — all delivered on budget and on time.  



**SCOPE OF POSITION / SUMMARY**


The Lifestyle Attendant is responsible for the organisation, coordination, monitoring and maintaining of their shift to ensure a smooth and efficient operation of all the exclusive Amenities including the Fitness Center, Spa facilities, the indoor and outdoor pool, the meeting room, the lounge areas, the library, the Golf Simulator and wet\-areas of the residences and any other health / outdoor activities provided.  

  

  



Also, the Lifestyle Agent is responsible for assisting and supporting Residential Concierge and Residential Porter with their full scope of duties duties.

  



**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

  



The Lifestyle Attendant reports to Lead Concierge and subsequently to the Director of Residences.

  



**DUTIES AND SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent responsibilities:  

  

  



* Effectively coordinates the usage of the Lifestyle area and Community activities.
* Review the cleanliness of the exclusive Amenities during the shift and maintain it in accordance with MOHG Standards (i.e. set up of treatment room, maintain the stock of towels, water, etc… at the fitness centre and changing rooms, disinfection of fitness equipment, etc…)
* Proactively greet, interact, and assist residence owners in a professional manner.
* Identify and report defects throughout the residential area; notify the Residences Management team immediately of hazards, injuries, equipment or processes that negatively affect the operations.
* Report all requests and complaints to the Residences Management team to ensure issues are resolved immediately and followed up to ensure the resident’s satisfaction.
* To aid therapists and private practitioners in setting up for treatments as well as clearing away after.
* To ensure that lockers are stocked with clean linen at all times and removing soiled items.
* To ensure fitness center is always clean and with sufficient stock of towels, drinks, etc…
* Make sure all equipment at fitness center is disinfected after every use.
* To attend to residents in all areas, ensuring that they are comfortable as well as offering refreshments.
* Be knowledgeable with AV equipment and be able to set up equipment on demand.
* Maintain complete knowledge and comply with all residential and Management Company departmental policies and procedures.
* Maintain correct records for FLHSS audit.
* Maintain strict confidentiality relative to Residents and Residences business.
* Practice teamwork, create a positive work environment, greet fellow employees and thank them when they lend assistance.
* Proactively seek to provide refined luxury service ensuring resident satisfaction.
* Ability to focus attention on resident needs, remaining calm and courteous.
* Assist Residential Concierge in any duty deemed appropriate by the Concierge such as the delivery / pick up / purchase of desk services, for those services that need to be performed away from the desk such as deliveries of food, laundry, etc…
* Anticipate residents’ needs, respond promptly and acknowledge all residents, however busy and whatever time of day.
* Accommodate all Residents requests expediently and courteously. Follow up with designated Residential or Management Company personnel to ensure completion of request.
* Protect and utilise Management Company assets in a responsible and professional manner.
* Participate in the property’s sustainability initiative through energy conservation and the use of recycling programs and materials.
* Always show a professional attitude, particularly with regard to punctuality, appearance and general manner.
* Provide food and beverage service upon resident request, ensuring a seamless and personalized experience.
* To carry out any other reasonable requests as directed by your manager.

  



**REQUIREMENTS ON CORE COMPETENCIES**

  



The Lifestyle Agent requires the following personal attributes:


* Delighting our Customers


* Delighting our Colleagues


* Communicates a compelling vision
* Inspires co\-operation and commitment
* Adapts work style and ethics appropriately
* Actively listens and builds on other ideas
* Effectively understands and uses resources
* Is culturally sensitive
* Good written and verbal skills

  



* Becoming the Best


* Achievement orientated
* Makes things happen
* Has presence
* Has positive impact and influence
* Generates, innovative options
* Adapts plans to suit change
* Seeks continuous improvement opportunities

  



* Working together


* Has energy and drive
* A sense of urgency
* Motivating individual
* Communicates clearly
* Open to feedback and learning
* Operates ethically
* High level of personal integrity


* Acting with Responsibility


* Can identify core issues and problems
* Emotionally stable and mature
* Accepts feedback
* Coaches others
* Manages responsibilities

  



**Requirements – Experience, Skills, Education and Qualifications**
-------------------------------------------------------------------


* Have a minimum of one year’s experience in similar position, preferably in a luxury environment.
* Excellent communication skills in all aspects.
* To be passionate about delivering the very best recreation, fitness and leisure experience for your residents.
* Approachable, confident, composed, and is able to work well in a team environment.
* Flexible work hours to meet the demands of the operation.
* Good verbal skills in Spanish and English.

description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Associate / Associate Director SCS
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are seeking an Associate/Associate Director to join our EMEA Strategic Capital Solutions team based in London, Madrid or Frankfurt. The team combines our Real Estate Investment Banking and Pan European Capital Markets Sector teams as an integrated, market\-leading platform.
  
We specialise in complex, multi\-stakeholder transactions including large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, recapitalisations, joint ventures, new funds and structured equity transactions. The team operates from offices in London, Madrid, and Frankfurt, within a highly motivated, high\-performing, investment\-banking\-style environment that values initiative, analytical rigor, and ambition.
  
As Associate/Associate Director, you'll be a trusted member of the team supporting directors throughout the full life cycle of projects. You will play an active role in live client processes, participating in client meetings and maintaining relationships. You'll also mentor analysts, graduates and junior team members, helping develop their financial analysis skills and understanding of the real estate market.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Execution Leadership:** Ensure quality and timeliness of all client\-facing materials and transaction documentation while coordinating multiple workstreams, anticipating execution obstacles, and demonstrating ownership of transaction outcomes.
  
  

**Transaction Management:** Manage complex transactions including joint ventures, corporate M\&A, portfolio and asset sales, maintaining clear communication between multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities across simultaneous transactions.
  
  

**Sector Specialisation Development:** Build depth of market intelligence within preferred asset classes or product types, producing high\-quality sector/product\-specific technical analyses
  
  

**Client\-Facing Capability:** Present marketing materials and transaction updates with professionalism, respond effectively to technical client questions, and serve as point of contact externally.
  
  

**Financial Modelling and Analysis:** Create and interpret financial models for large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, joint ventures, and structured equity transactions, providing strategic advice based on financial analysis and market trends with efficient turnaround times.
  
  

**Pitch Preparation and Business Development:** Support preparation and coordination of pitches for potential projects, develop creative business opportunities, and execute investor marketing strategies to grow the team pipeline.
  
  

**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Develop connections with local teams to support investment processes, manage research team outputs, coordinate with marketing teams, and build relationships with internal specialist teams including sustainability.
  
  

**Team Leadership and Development:** Effectively supervise analyst team members on assigned deals, mentor graduates and junior team members on financial analysis and appraisal outputs, and support their professional development.
  
  

What Are We Looking For?
  
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience in investment banking / corporate finance with exposure to real estate, or real estate capital markets
  
Sustained excellence across execution responsibilities over 3\+ years
  
Strong financial modeling capabilities \- comfortable building and critically analyzing financial and valuation models and working with complex operating data
  
Sound understanding of financial statements and how operational metrics drive platform / property value
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Consistent leadership on transactions
  
Excellent project management and organisational abilities with proven ability to manage multiple workstreams
  
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders
  
Proven track record in independent client relationship management and business development
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  
Ability to mentor and develop junior team members
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Expert proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
Willingness to travel regularly throughout Europe for client meetings and site inspections
  
Additional European languages are beneficial but not essential
  
  

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well\-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.
  
  

**We offer:**  

Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment
  
Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
  
Global exposure within a leading real estate services firm
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
