title: People Operations Shared Service Specialist
description:
**Company Description**  

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95\+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

 **Job Description**  

We are currently seeking a People Operations Shared Service Specialist to join our dynamic team in Madrid, supporting our People Operations activities across France.


We are looking for someone with the right mindset above all, someone who is service\-oriented, solutions\-focused and proactive, with a genuine desire to anticipate the needs of People Managers and deliver a positive experience throughout the employee lifecycle.


In this role, you will provide first\-level People Operations support and guidance to Department Heads, responding to queries relating to HR and payroll policies, procedures and programmes. Queries will be managed through a ticketing system according to priority, with complex or sensitive matters escalated to the People Operations Business Partner for France, where appropriate.


You will provide comprehensive administrative support across the employee lifecycle, from recruitment and pre\-employment through to onboarding, employee changes and post\-hire administration. This will include, but is not limited to:

* Posting and closing vacancies through SmartRecruiters and Workday.
* Initiating and validating position and employee changes in Workday.
* Supporting the recruitment process and gathering feedback to help continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
* Managing a range of HR administration through Workday, the ATS and other People \& Culture systems and tools.
* Providing general HR and payroll administration support.

**Onboarding \& Employee Experience**


You will work closely with Department Heads to ensure a smooth, engaging and positive onboarding experience for new colleagues.


This will include:

* Preparing and sending onboarding documentation.
* Reviewing and validating required forms to ensure compliance and appropriate benefits setup.
* Configuring onboarding workflows and ensuring relevant information and access are in place within Workday.
* Supporting new hire communications and announcements.
* Gathering feedback and identifying opportunities to continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Performance Management**


Support the administration and coordination of the performance management process, working closely with the People Operations Business Partner for France and the HRIS team.

**HR Administration \& Compliance**


Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records and HR documentation, ensuring compliance with legal requirements, RHG standards, processes and appropriate authorisation protocols.


Provide additional support across benefits administration, leave management and other People Operations activities as required.

**Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**


Work closely with the People Operations Business Partner and the wider People Operations Shared Services team to deliver an efficient, consistent and high\-quality service.


You will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve the employee and manager experience and enhance the way People Operations services are delivered.

 **Qualifications**  

* Previous experience in Human Resources, People Operations, personnel administration, training and development, or a similar role.
* Experience within the hospitality or wider service industry is highly desirable.
* Good understanding of HR and payroll processes, policies and best practices.
* Experience using Workday, SmartRecruiters or similar HRIS/ATS platforms would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong communication and customer service skills, with a proactive and solutions\-focused approach.
* Excellent attention to detail, organisation and confidentiality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work to deadlines and adapt to a fast\-paced and changing environment without compromising quality.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the confidence to know when an issue requires escalation.

  

**Additional Information**  

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?  

  

Live the Magic of Hospitality \- Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.  

  

Build a Great Career \- No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development, helping you reach your full potential.  

  

Experience the Team Spirit \- Join a workplace that’s inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.  

  

Lead with Your Ambition \- Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference—in hospitality, your community and beyond.  

  

Enjoy Global \& Local Perks \- No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits \- like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!  

  

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you’re ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we’d love to hear from you.  

  

Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.  

  

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

title: Service Instructor - Sommelier
description:
**Service Instructor \- Sommelier**

**Permanent contract** / Marbella, Spain


Les Roches Global Hospitality Education, in the top 3 for Hospitality \& Leisure Management by the QS World University Ranking, is a brand of the Sommet Education Group. Founded in 1954, Les Roches is a private institution based on the Swiss model of experiential learning, offering undergraduate and graduate degrees in the fields of hospitality, tourism and event management. Les Roches prepares entrepreneurial and innovative graduates across a global network of campuses in Crans\-Montana (Switzerland), Marbella (Spain) and Abu Dhabi (UAE).


You share our values: Development, Distinctiveness, Joint commitment, Openness and Sense of service.

**Your profile:**

* Certification as a sommelier or a degree in hospitality is beneficial.
* Food handling certificate.
* High level of English essential, Spanish a plus.
* Minimum of 2\-3 previous experience as a sommelier, wine steward, or in a hospitality role.
* Extensive knowledge on wines and regions of the different types.
* Knowledge of local vineyards and wineries.
* Computer skills an advantage.
* Working in a team.
* Efficient communication skills.
* Strong oenology skills.
* Large volume service and time management.
* Previous experience as a sommelier, wine steward, or in a hospitality role.
* 2\-3 years minimum sommelier.

**Main tasks and responsibilities:**

* This is a position for an energetic individual, who will be able to integrate and assume responsibilities in any outlets and strive to achieve excellence every day.
* To actively educate and train students in different areas through practical classes together with fellow instructors, transmitting them knowledge, values, aptitudes, and the best abilities to attend to their needs and for their professional future.
* To actively contribute to driving sales, recommending wine varieties to our guests, supervising wine serving and collaborating with winemakers to renew our selections and achieve better prices.
* Prepare/setup operations according to criteria.
* To follow ordering protocol.
* Control and preservation of stock.
* Implement HACCP and product control in the various sections.
* Flexible working schedules, days, hours to comply with the job.
* Assist in teaching, according to the syllabus for each group.
* To be innovative and consistent in quality control.
* Effective communication/work with the students and Instructors.
* To implement the procedures of behavior and absences as per requirements.
* Provide feedback and support to the instructors concerning student evolvement.
* Creating and updating wine lists with the head sommelier and manager.
* Making recommendations on food and wine pairings.
* Ensuring that the wine cellar is fully stocked.
* Informing guests on the variety of wines available.
* Organizing wine tasting events.

description:

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.


**Job Description**

This is a **hybrid** role. As a **Marketing Administration Executive** , you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day running of marketing operations across France, Spain and Portugal. Acting as the backbone of the regional marketing team, you will coordinate key administrative processes, manage budgets and supplier payments, support compliance requirements, and help ensure marketing activity is delivered efficiently and in line with internal processes.


Reporting to the **Head of Southwestern Europe** , you will be part of the **Southwestern Europe Marketing Team** , who are responsible for developing and delivering local marketing strategies and campaigns across France, Spain and Portugal. The team works closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders to drive growth, strengthen brand presence and deliver impactful customer experiences across multiple markets. This role plays a vital part in supporting the operational effectiveness of the team and ensuring marketing activity can be executed seamlessly.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast\-paced international marketing team, where you'll gain exposure to a broad range of marketing activities and collaborate with colleagues across multiple functions and markets. You'll have the chance to make a tangible impact by improving processes, supporting key stakeholders, and helping the team operate effectively. If you're highly organised, detail\-oriented and enjoy being at the centre of a busy, collaborative environment, **could this be the perfect next step for you?**

You Will:


* Coordinate the creation, tracking and renewal of marketing contracts, ensuring the correct approval processes are followed and records are maintained accurately.
* Raise and track purchase orders across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring spend aligns with approved budgets and supplier requirements.
* Process and monitor marketing invoices, working closely with suppliers, Finance and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and support timely payments.
* Maintain budget trackers, reconciliations and reporting updates, providing marketing teams with accurate visibility of committed and actual spend.
* Support procurement and supplier onboarding activities by coordinating required information, following up approvals and keeping stakeholders informed.
* Coordinate marketing\-related compliance information requirements across France, Spain and Portugal, ensuring information is collected, organised and submitted on time.
* Organise and maintain marketing files, records and trackers, ensuring information is accurate, accessible and up to date.
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to the regional marketing team, including meeting coordination, supplier follow\-up, document preparation and process management.
* Build strong working relationships with Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance and external partners to ensure smooth and efficient delivery of marketing operations.

**Qualifications**

You Have:


* Works carefully and accurately, checking details before sharing information or moving a process forward.
* Plans work clearly, keeps trackers up to date and follows through on agreed actions.
* Collaborates well with colleagues across different markets and functions, adapting communication to the person and situation.
* Asks questions early when something is unclear and follows the right approval routes.
* Responds calmly to changing priorities and helps others understand what is needed to keep work moving.
* Looks for simple improvements that make recurring administration easier, clearer and more consistent.

**Additional Information**

**Benefits**

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire you. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:


* A regular bonus and great pension.
* €9\.60 food vouchers per day.

* A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

title: Principal Country HR Partner - Fixed Term
description:
### **Strength in Trust**



OneTrust's mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn't slow teams down—it should accelerate what's possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

### **Strength in Trust**



OneTrust's mission is to enable organizations to use data and AI responsibly. Our platform simplifies collecting data with consent and preferences, automates data governance with integrated risk management across privacy, security, IT/tech, third\-party, and AI risk, and enables responsible data use by applying and enforcing data policies across the entire data estate and lifecycle. Recognized as a market pioneer and leader, OneTrust serves more than 14,000 customers globally.


### **The Challenge**



We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Senior Principal / Director, HR Country Manager to serve as the HR leader for our Madrid office, our hub for the EMEA region. This role will be based in Madrid and will provide visible, on\-site leadership for the site while partnering closely with local leaders and global People stakeholders on both day\-to\-day operations and broader business strategy. The role combines executive partnership, strong operational and compliance oversight, and hands\-on support for complex people matters in Spain. This leader will also spend part of their time mentoring the current senior HR country leader to help strengthen their capability and develop toward a broader site leadership scope.


### **Your Mission**



To translate business strategy into a Spain people strategy that enables growth, leadership effectiveness, organizational health, compliance, and employee experience for the Madrid site and broader Spain employee population. This leader will ensure that OneTrust's global People philosophy is applied thoughtfully in Spain while advising leaders on local market realities, regulatory risk, workforce planning, and high\-impact people decisions.


### **You Are**



A seasoned HR leader with strong business acumen, sound judgment, and credibility with senior stakeholders. You bring deep expertise in Spanish employment law and labor practices, a track record of leading through complexity and change, and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands\-on execution. You are pragmatic, data\-driven, and comfortable operating as both a site\-level operator and a strategic business partner in a fast\-moving, multinational environment.


### **Main Tasks \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as the senior in\-person HR leader for Spain and the effective HR Manager for the Madrid site, acting as the primary advisor to local leaders on organizational strategy, people risk, workforce effectiveness, and leadership decision\-making.
* Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, talent strategy, retention priorities, and organizational change aligned to business goals.
* Translate global People strategies into Spain market execution that is legally compliant, culturally relevant, and operationally scalable, while ensuring strong partnership across People Business Partnership, People Operations, Payroll, HRIS, Total Rewards, Finance, and Legal.
* Lead complex employee relations, investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, restructures, and sensitive exits in Spain, including representing the company at SMAC conciliation proceedings where required and guiding leaders through legally informed decision\-making.
* Own Spain labor and statutory compliance across the employee lifecycle, including employment documentation, policy localization, working time and leave practices, separation requirements and execution, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives such as the establishment and ongoing governance of the Equality Plan for the Spanish entity.
* Identify and recommend policy, process, and controls updates to mitigate risk and maintain audit readiness.
* Provide strategic HR leadership for organizational changes, manager capability, team health, and culture, ensuring leaders are equipped to make fair, consistent, and business\-aligned people decisions.
* Use HR metrics and workforce analytics to identify trends, assess organizational health and compliance risk, and recommend actions to improve employee experience, manager effectiveness, and operational performance.
* Mentor the current HR country partner and local team to help broaden their capability and support their development toward stronger site leadership and support remits.

### **Minimum Education and Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree in HR, business, or a related field preferred.
* Deep knowledge of Spain employment law, labor practices, statutory compliance, and employee relations frameworks, including experience with sensitive exits, conciliation processes, and practical application of local requirements in a business setting.
* Direct experience leading Equality Plan design, implementation, governance, and related compliance initiatives within Spain, inclusive of a strong track record representing company interests with employee representative bodies.
* Strong experience with HRIS platforms and reporting tools; Workday strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical capability and comfort using data to influence executive decisions and improve HR effectiveness; professional HR certification is a plus.
* Fluency in Spanish and English required.

### **Background \& Experience**


* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, including meaningful experience in senior HR leadership, HRBP, country HR, or director\-level roles.
* Experience as the leading HR partner for one or more offices is required.
* Proven experience leading complex employee relations, investigations, restructures, sensitive exits, and legally informed decision\-making.
* Strong track record of operating in Spain's regulatory environment and applying local requirements within a global or multinational company context.
* Experience leading or influencing cross\-functional teams and driving execution through ambiguity, scale, and change.
* Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and the ability to balance strategic leadership with operational rigor.

### **Where we Work**



We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.



Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.


### **Benefits**



As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you'll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.


### **Resources**

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:


* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

### **Your Data**



You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview**.** You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

  



Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.


### **Our Commitment to You**



When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.



OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high\-performance, player\-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. **Introduction:**


As Senior Director, Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, you will be the operational partner to the Chief Information Security Officer and act on their behalf during periods of delegated absence.


This role has a clear focus: strengthening application and product security across digital products, platforms and connected medical devices, while supporting the execution of Straumann Group’s wider cybersecurity strategy.

* Working closely with Product Development, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Trust \& Assurance, Security Operations, Legal, Privacy and strategic technology partners, you will help ensure security risks, exceptions and remediation decisions are clearly documented and well governed.
* You will also support the CISO in translating cybersecurity strategy into measurable execution, lead selected cross\-functional security priorities, resolve issues across product and technology teams, and represent the CISO in internal or external forums when delegated.

* You bring significant leadership experience in cybersecurity, application security, product security or software security.
* You have built or led application and product security capabilities in a complex enterprise environment.
* You understand secure software development, DevSecOps, modern application architectures, cloud\-native applications, APIs, identity, CI/CD pipelines and software supply\-chain security.
* You have experience with threat modelling, security architecture, penetration testing and vulnerability management.
* You are confident engaging senior stakeholders, auditors and regulators, and can translate cybersecurity and regulatory requirements into practical, risk\-based controls.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/  

  

About Us:  

  

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.  

  

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.  

  

About the Role:  

  

The Strategic Partner Manager (SPM) supports the ongoing success of creators across the Twitch Partner program and plays a vital role in bringing new creators into the ecosystem. This role spans Creator Recruitment, Account Management, and Community Engagement, requiring a balance of analytical thinking and relationship management skills.  

  

The role will work from Madrid, Spain and report into the Director of Global Spanish Partnerships.  

  

You Will:  

  

Creator Recruitment  

* Identify, evaluate, and reach out to high\-potential creators who are new to Twitch or transitioning to livestreaming
* Guide creators through structured onboarding covering analytics, audience development, channel setup, and monetization fundamentals, support.
* Conduct stream reviews and support test\-streaming to ensure smooth creator starts
* Maintain visibility in emerging creator communities across platforms (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, etc.

  

Partner Touchpoints \& Account Management
  

* Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of Twitch Partners
* Provide timely, high\-quality support and guidance on Twitch products, policies, and best practices
* Maintain accurate documentation of creator interactions and portfolio data in Salesforce
* Collect and log partner feedback to inform product development and messaging
* Community Management \& Events (15% of time)
* Support planning and execution of IRL events to deepen creator relationships
* Maintain active presence in Partner community spaces (e.g., Discord)
* Represent Twitch at creator community moments as a brand ambassador
* Document creator insights and event outcomes

  

Administrative \& Strategic Tasks  

* Generate and maintain reports on creator performance and engagement
* Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities within creator portfolio
* Participate in cross\-functional meetings and initiatives
* Support development of scalable solutions for creator needs

  

Team Collaboration  

* Work closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, and other teams
* Participate in regular team meetings and planning sessions
* Share insights and best practices with broader partnerships team
* Contribute to process improvements and team initiatives

  

Success Metrics  

* Creator recruitment and onboarding targets
* Partner retention and satisfaction rates
* Response time and quality of support
* Event participation and outcomes
* Documentation quality and timeliness
* Cross\-functional collaboration effectiveness

  

Perks  

* Private Medical Insurance
* Dental, Vision \& Life Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Maternity \& Parental Leave
* Paid Time Off \& Holidays
* Commuter Benefits
* Amazon Employee Discount

  

About the team  

The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our partner managers are custodians of meaningful and enduring relationships with our Partners. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience in client/partner management, content acquisition, or related fields
* Demonstrated experience in relationship management and business development
* Strong analytical and communication skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

title: Sr. Analyst , Global Operational Excellence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Please note: This job is advertised for Luxembourg but can be located in any of our EU sites or offices.  

  

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to own the analytical backbone across multiple high\-impact domains within EU Inbound Supply Chain. This is not a single\-metric reporting role you will design scalable data architectures, build production\-grade analytics systems, and drive strategic decisions through data, working across both real\-time streaming and batch processing to get the team the right data at the right time.  

  

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and turn ambiguous business problems into measurable solutions. You're equally comfortable building scalable pipelines on AWS services over terabytes of data, architecting a real\-time monitoring solution, presenting to senior leadership, or prototyping GenAI tools to scale analytical capacity.  

  

What makes this role unique:  

\- Context\-switching is the job \- one week you're decomposing a delivery\-accuracy variance across the EU network; the next you're building a real\-time Inbound Management pipeline; the week after you're prototyping a GenAI tool that auto\-generates root\-cause narratives for business reviews.  

\- Federated stakeholder model \- you'll work across Engineering, Science, Transportation, Planning, Finance, and Operations. Aligning on definitions and building shared analytical frameworks matters as much as writing the code.  

\- GenAI as a force multiplier \- you won't just use AI tools, you'll build them: agentic deep\-dives, automated narrative generation, and intelligent alerting that scale analysis across inbound speed, DEA, and transportation optimization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and own end\-to\-end data architectures spanning real\-time streaming (Kinesis, Flink) and batch processing (EMR, Redshift, Athena), selecting the right paradigm for the latency, volume, and criticality at hand.
* Build production\-grade, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi\-TB datasets daily across Redshift, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB with data\-quality checks, monitoring, and alerting.
* Architect real\-time analytics for operational monitoring: live visibility into inbound flows, delivery accuracy, dock congestion, and network disruptions.
* Own metric frameworks and reporting: design KPIs, build automated dashboards (QuickSight), support WBR/MBR narratives, and own the “why” through root\-cause analysis when metrics move.
* Develop GenAI\-driven tooling and agentic workflows that automate reporting narratives and root\-cause analysis, reducing time\-to\-insight from days to minutes.
* Drive deep\-dive investigations across complex, multi\-source datasets tracing issues to specific products, warehouses, or routes, then quantifying network\-wide impact with statistical methods.

  

A day in the life  

You'll have exposure to the full data\-product lifecycle — from defining metrics to designing architectures, building pipelines, and delivering insights to senior leadership. A typical week might include:  

* Designing pipelines that unify real\-time event streams (shipment scans, trailer movements, inventory updates) and batch sources (forecasts, historical performance) into a single analytical layer.
* Writing advanced SQL across multiple sources to investigate why delivery promises were missed from the customer order through placement, transportation, and fulfillment.
* Building Python\-based automation for anomaly detection, statistical modeling, and reporting.
* Iterating on GenAI\-powered tools and presenting data\-driven recommendations, with clear quantification of customer and cost impact, to senior leadership.
* Triaging emerging operational issues from real\-time dashboards and providing data\-backed context.

  

About the team  

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon’s EU fulfillment network and ROW. We work at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved, and delivered reducing costs while improving customer experience. Our team leverages large\-scale data analysis, automation, and cross\-functional collaboration to solve complex supply chain challenges across Inbound Speed, Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), and network performance.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, engineering, or operations research.
* Experience in analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence at a large\-scale enterprise, including data\-warehouse architecture, data modeling, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
* Advanced SQL and programming (Python or equivalent) to extract, transform, and clean large (multi\-TB) datasets, plus scripting for pipeline automation and scheduling.
* Experience with both real\-time streaming (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) and batch processing (e.g., EMR, Hive) systems, and with data\-visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar).
* Experience translating operational problems into analytical solutions and communicating results to senior leadership (Director/VP) with clear business\-impact quantification.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, or an equivalent quantitative field.
* Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, SageMaker, and DynamoDB.


\- Experience with GenAI/LLM integration \- building AI\-assisted analytical tools, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or agentic workflows.  

* Experience with statistical analysis and experimentation (design of experiments, causal inference, A/B testing) and ML/data\-mining pipelines.
* Knowledge of supply\-chain operations (inventory placement, network optimization, transportation, fulfillment) and Amazon internal data systems (Andes/Redshift, Cradle, Data Central, EDX).

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca is looking for a **Social Media Manager** to join our **Sales \& Marketing Team.**


Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.


Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.


Set against the stunning backdrop of Puerto Portals, Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra pulses with the vibrant spirit of Mallorca. Here, subtle and emotional luxury seamlessly blend with the island’s natural beauty and energy, offering a place where inspiration flows effortlessly. Celebrate the essence of Mallorca through bespoke experiences, dynamic culinary journeys, and rejuvenating wellness \- each designed to immerse you in the island’s vibrant atmosphere and extraordinary offerings.


**About the job**


Based at Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca, as the Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing social media strategies in order to increase online presence and improve marketing and sales efforts of the resort and its outlets. This position works closely with different departments to develop and execute the story telling at the resort.


**As Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**


* With the guidance of the Director of Marketing Communications, design and implement the hotel’s social media and e\-commerce strategy with KPIs.
* Proactively plan creative, compelling, and targeted social media activity and campaigns.
* Stay informed of upcoming trends and developments within the field of social media.
* Research and develop new ways to leverage social content to improve performance.
* Setting KPIs for social media agencies and using relevant social media monitoring tools to manage all the resort’s social channels.
* Conduct competitive analysis of studies on competition and provide recommendations on content changes for the resort’s social channels.
* Oversee and manage all social media accounts for the resort, including each F\&B outlet, while leading community management strategies and daily engagement for every account.
* Prepare and implement the annual social media content strategy in accordance to brand.
* Plan and execute social media influencer campaigns, working closely with local and/or international influencers / KOLs and with the Public Relations agency.
* Collaborate create and execute social media campaigns that will generate leads, drive quality traffic and fans/follower’s engagement.
* Prepare monthly reports on social media for distribution to department heads and executive committee.
* Work closely with various departments to produce quality content for social media.
* Writing, commissioning, and editing materials for a range of key hotel audiences for use across all social media platforms.
* Plan, organize and oversee all social media photography / videography sessions.
**As Social Media Manager, we expect from you:**


Experience and education


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, eCommerce Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of solid experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality sector (resort experience is considered a plus).
Technical Skills


* Excellent communication skills with an articulate and compelling communication style.
* Strong writing ability, capable of adapting tone and style to different audiences and communication platforms.
* Proven project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
* Creative mindset with the ability to think innovatively and work with flair and imagination.
* Strong communication skills in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
**Our commitment to you**


* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the \#MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Health \& Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work\-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
**We’re Fans. Are you?**

Hyatt is looking for an Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects to join the Digital \& Direct Channel team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, working under a hybrid model.


In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Hyatt’s direct channels through the planning, execution, and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, as well as the coordination of projects related to the digital and web experience. You will work with regional and global teams, hotels, agencies, and external partners to drive customer and World of Hyatt member acquisition, conversion, engagement, loyalty, and retention.

  

**Who We Are**

  

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and in creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and guests have been at the heart of our business and have helped Hyatt become one of the world’s leading and fastest\-growing hospitality companies.


Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

  

**The Role**

  

Reporting to the Director, Digital \& Direct Channels South EAME, the **Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects** will be responsible for coordinating the strategy, execution, and optimization of CRM initiatives, digital campaigns, and projects related to the web and digital ecosystem.

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

  

* Coordinate campaigns, tactics, and touchpoints aimed at Hyatt guests and World of Hyatt members, using segmentation, personalization, and data analysis to improve engagement, conversion, and direct bookings.
* Manage the relationship calendar and ensure the proper alignment of campaigns with commercial, regional, global, and hotel priorities.
* Lead the execution and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, ensuring alignment with direct\-channel performance objectives.
* Coordinate promotions and activations across the digital ecosystem, managing timelines, content, assets, and messaging across different touchpoints.
* Act as a liaison between Digital Marketing, Web, Contact Center, Revenue Management, Operations, eDistribution, and Marketing teams.
* Coordinate digital projects from end to end, managing milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
* Monitor performance, define and track CRM KPIs, and prepare reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Analyze customer behavior and feedback to continuously improve CRM initiatives and the digital customer experience.
* Ensure CRM processes comply with GDPR and best practices in data governance and data quality.
* Coordinate relationships with CRM and digital agencies across South EAME and the wider EAME region, ensuring consistency in strategy, reporting, execution, and best\-practice adoption.

**Who You Are**

  

You are passionate about improving the customer experience through data, technology, and creativity. You are organized, collaborative, and results\-oriented, with the ability to coordinate complex projects and connect teams with different perspectives.


You also share Hyatt’s core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing.

  

**We Welcome You**

  

Research shows that individuals often apply for jobs only when they meet all the listed qualifications. If you do not meet every requirement but feel inspired by this opportunity and believe you can bring value, we encourage you to apply.


We would love to learn more about your experience and discover how you could help make Hyatt even better.

------------------


**Qualifications**

  

* At least 3 years of professional experience in CRM, digital marketing, digital campaigns, or a closely related field.
* Experience planning, executing, and analyzing digital and CRM campaigns.
* Experience coordinating projects and working with multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Experience working with external agencies, preferably in regional or international environments.
* Knowledge of marketing, digital analytics, CRM, personalization, content, ecommerce, and cloud\-based technology platforms.

title: Associate Director, Capability Building & Change Management
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------


We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------



We are looking for an Associate Director, Capability Building \& Change Management to own and drive communication, change management, internal branding, asset creation, and capability\-building activities as part of Global Procurement Transformation. This role will shape how teams understand transformation priorities, adopt new tools and ways of working, engage with AI\-enabled and technology\-driven change, and build the capabilities needed in a more digital, data\-driven, and agile procurement environment.


The successful candidate will work closely with procurement leaders, subject matter experts, digital teams, global L\&D, technology partners, and external providers to lead clear communication, practical change adoption, targeted learning enablement, and compelling transformation storytelling. The role will bring structure, pace, and ownership to change activities, connect the right experts, align priorities, create reusable communication and enablement assets, and ensure Global Procurement Transformation changes are understood, supported, branded consistently, and embedded over time.

**Location**
------------



Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------


* **Own communication and stakeholder engagement for Global Procurement Transformation**
* Develop clear, audience\-relevant communication plans for Global Procurement Transformation priorities, initiatives, and activities.
* Translate complex business, process, and technology topics into simple messages that explain what is changing, why it matters, what support is available, and what actions are expected.
* Equip leaders and managers with messaging, materials, engagement moments, and communication assets that build understanding, confidence, and alignment.
* Develop communication assets, internal branding materials, launch narratives, leadership messages, FAQs, toolkits, and adoption content that create a consistent identity for procurement transformation and make change easier to understand and engage with.
* **Drive change management and adoption of new ways of working**
* Lead change readiness, stakeholder impact assessment, adoption planning, and reinforcement for procurement tools, processes, digital solutions, and AI\-enabled use cases where relevant.
* Support deployment of new procurement technologies and tools by shaping launch plans, adoption campaigns, readiness materials, and reinforcement activities that help users move from awareness to confident usage.
* Bring AI transformation into the change agenda by helping teams understand AI\-enabled use cases, responsible adoption expectations, capability needs, and practical examples of how AI can improve procurement work.
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, resistance, confusion, or capability gaps, and drive practical actions to address them.
* Partner with transformation, digital, process, and procurement teams to embed new ways of working into day\-to\-day routines and sustain momentum.
* Drive reinforcement activities that encourage sustained usage, behavior change, and measurable adoption over time.
* **Support procurement capability building and learning enablement**
* Build and maintain a practical procurement capability roadmap aligned with Global Procurement Transformation priorities, business needs, and future skills requirements.
* Help identify priority capability gaps across technical, digital, data, communication, change, and soft skills.
* Partner with procurement subject matter experts and global L\&D to translate specialist knowledge into practical learning, playbooks, communication assets, and adoption materials.
* Create practical enablement assets such as playbooks, one\-pagers, launch packs, quick reference guides, demo scripts, user communications, and adoption toolkits for new tools, AI\-enabled solutions, and transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate learning and enablement activities that build confidence, strengthen adoption, and improve team effectiveness.
* **Track progress and drive continuous improvement**
* Track simple, meaningful indicators for learning participation, adoption, capability uplift, and business impact where measurable.
* Use feedback, usage data, and stakeholder input to continuously improve learning content, adoption support, and the overall user experience.
* Partner with global L\&D operations to manage learning logistics, platform activities, and reporting with clear ownership and follow\-through.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------


* Master’s degree preferred; relevant certification in change management, learning and development, project/program management, or procurement is an advantage.
* 7\+ years of relevant experience in Procurement in a global corporate environment; experience with AI Transformations, supporting program communications, change management, procurement transformation, learning enablement, or functional capability programs is highly preferred
* Ability to create clear communication plans and support change readiness, impact assessment, adoption planning, reinforcement, and measurement for new ways of working.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, audience\-relevant messages.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled technologies, data, Microsoft Office applications, collaboration platforms, learning technologies, and communication asset creation tools.
**Also Good to Have**
---------------------


* Experience in program communications, change management, stakeholder engagement, capability building, or learning enablement within a global corporate or functional environment.
* Practical understanding of communication and change management activities, including readiness, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, reinforcement, and measurement.
* Strong communication, storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and tailor messages for different audiences.
* A practical, delivery\-oriented mindset, with the ability to coordinate cross\-functional initiatives, manage change activities, and turn plans into clear actions.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled solutions, data\-driven ways of working, and technology\-enabled business transformation, including the ability to translate technology change into practical user adoption support.
* Ability to create engaging transformation assets and internal branding materials that make complex programs feel coherent, accessible, and easy to adopt across a global audience.
* Procurement, learning academy, digital adoption, change network, or learning platform experience would be an advantage.

**About H2SITE:**

Founded in 2020 in Bilbao, Spain, it emerged as a spin\-off from two renowned research and development centers in collaboration with ENGIE New Ventures as its first industrial investor: TECNALIA, the largest private research center in Southern Europe specializing in membranes and material sciences among other fields, and the Eindhoven University of Technology (TUe), a reference in process intensification. We have developed a technology of membrane reactors for the separation and production of hydrogen in situ from different feedstocks, such as ammonia, methanol, formic acid, syngas from waste…

  

**Mission:**

 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family\-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI\-powered Personal \& Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self\-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

 Our long\-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI\-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
   

**The Role**
 As a
 **Content Marketing Manager** 
 at Air Apps, you will be responsible for
 **developing and executing a content strategy** 
 that positions us as a thought leader in the industry. You will create
 **engaging, high\-quality content** 
 such as
 **blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, and email campaigns** 
 to educate and attract users.
   

 This role requires a mix of
 **storytelling, SEO expertise, and data\-driven decision\-making** 
 to grow our audience and increase brand visibility.
   

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute a content strategy that aligns with business goals and target audiences.
* Write, edit, and manage high\-quality blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, eBooks, and email campaigns.
* Conduct keyword research and SEO optimization to improve content visibility and search rankings.
* Collaborate with designers, developers, and product teams to create compelling content assets.
* Manage the content calendar to ensure consistent publication and engagement.
* Analyze content performance metrics and optimize for engagement, lead generation, and conversions.
* Develop brand messaging and storytelling that resonates with our audience.
* Research industry trends, competitor content, and best practices to refine strategy.

* Around 4\+ years of experience in content marketing, copywriting, or editorial roles.
* Exceptional writing and editing skills with a strong command of storytelling and brand voice.
* Experience with SEO tools (Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz) and content optimization techniques.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, inbound marketing, and content distribution.
* Ability to analyze content metrics and adapt strategies based on data insights.
* Experience managing content calendars, editorial workflows, and content management systems (CMS) like WordPress.
* Familiarity with email marketing tools (e.g., Mailchimp, HubSpot) is a plus.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, remote\-first environment.
* A portfolio of published work showcasing blog posts, whitepapers, or case studies.

* Remote\-first approach with flexible working hours.
* Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
* Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) to support work\-life balance.
* Annual Bonus.

* Air Conference 2025 in Las Vegas \- an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.

Our diverse, global team speaks over 10 languages whose ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry\-leading services and customer experiences.
   

  

**﻿Role Overview**
**The Social Media Video Editor \& Designer at CapsLock** 
 creates engaging, platform\-first video content for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook.
   

  

 The role is primarily focused on short\-form video editing — turning raw footage into polished, dynamic videos through strong pacing, storytelling, transitions, captions, sound, and motion graphics.
   

  

 It also calls for solid graphic design skills to produce supporting static assets such as graphics, thumbnails, overlays, and other visual elements when needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Edit engaging short\-form videos for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, with a focus on strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, and platform\-native formats.
* Turn raw footage into polished social content using cuts, captions, transitions, music, voiceovers, sound effects, and visual effects.
* Adapt and optimize content for different platforms, formats, aspect ratios, and technical requirements.


**Graphic Design \& Creative Development**
* Create motion graphics and supporting design assets, including overlays, text animations, thumbnails, static posts, and Stories.

 Requirements:
   

  

* 3\+ years of professional video editing and creative experience, ideally focused on social media and digital content.

* Strong video editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools.
* Graphic design skills using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar tools.

* Ability to follow brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas to content.
* Results\-driven mindset, with an understanding of how creative decisions can impact engagement and performance.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote\-first environment.


**Nice\-to\-Have Requirements**
* Experience with motion graphics, animation, or advanced visual effects.
* Experience creating content for influencer campaigns, UGC, or branded collaborations.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered video, design, and content creation tools.
* Understanding of social media algorithms, trends, and engagement strategies.
* Background in digital marketing or performance\-driven creative, with an understanding of how video content contributes to engagement, clicks, and conversions.


**What We Offer**
**Flexible Remote Work:**
* Enjoy the freedom to work from any comfortable location within the CET time zone, allowing you to create your ideal work environment.
* Competitive compensation package.
* Benefit from a highly competitive salary, reflective of your expertise and leadership skills in the design and marketing fields.


**Work\-Life balance:**
* Full\-time employment with a flexible schedule to accommodate your personal needs
* Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge

**Comprehensive benefits:**
* Attractive benefits package to support your health and well\-being

* Collaborate with a highly skilled and professional team
* Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement


**Unique work culture:**
* Join a diverse, international team that values innovation, creativity, and collaboration. Experience a work environment where your ideas and leadership can truly make an impact.

title: Deputy Director, Economic, Social, and Cultural Rights
description:
**FULL\-TIME JOB VACANCY**  

**Deputy Director, Economic, Social and Cultural Rights**  

**Environment, and Economic and Social Rights Division**  

**Multiple Locations Considered**  

**Application Deadline: October 6, 2026**



Human Rights Watch (HRW) is seeking a Deputy Director to lead its work on Economic, Social and Cultural (ESC) Rights with a focus on Health, Social Security, and Labor within a newly created Environment, and Economic and Social Rights Division. Candidates with deep expertise on public health, health and human rights, and health harms experienced by communities affected by fossil fuel pollution, are encouraged to apply. The Deputy will work as part of the division's management team and manage the ESC team responsible for this work, help develop and implement its strategy, coordinate with colleagues across HRW, uphold high standards of research and advocacy, and support fundraising for the division.



The successful candidate will be an effective leader, experienced in managing rigorous and complex research and maintaining organizational standards, and a compelling communicator with experience on key issues related to the position. They will have demonstrated experience developing and implementing strategic human rights interventions and understand how to bring innovate approaches to research, advocacy and communications to effect change.


**Position Overview**



The Deputy will be working with the Director and a new management team to supervise staff with an emphasis on diversity, equity and inclusion, managing stress and resilience of staff, and encouraging a healthy work/life balance while supervising and helping to develop areas of programmatic work consistent with HRW's strategy and the mandate of the new division. This full\-time position will be based in one of HRW's global offices, will work from the office on an as\-needed basis, and will report to the Director, based in Washington, D.C.


**Responsibilities:**



1\. Design and implement with the Director, divisional management team, and staff, a multi\-year strategy for the ESC team to advance research and advocacy consistent with the organization's Global Strategy and the mandate of the division;



2\. Help integrate members of the new division and provide day\-to\-day management and strategic leadership of the ESC team to develop, implement, and oversee strategies to advance this key area of work; help the team keep abreast of current research and discourse on these issues;



3\. Manage research ensuring sound project selection, rigorous investigative research methodologies, and compliance with organizational standards and mandate;



4\. Coordinate with other parts of the organization to strategically guide and advance work on these areas of work through support for research, helping to develop innovative communications and advocacy products, and developing new policies to support this work;



5\. Act as a senior representative and advocate for the work of the division internally;



6\. Act as a senior spokesperson and liaise with external actors to advocate on the work of the division;



7\. Represent HRW and the work of the division externally;



8\. Foster meaningful and equitable partnerships when working with local organizations and other movement partners;



9\. Work with HRW's development staff as needed to support HRW's fundraising efforts;



10\. Work with colleagues in advocacy and communications to develop multidisciplinary strategies to support the work to achieve impact;



11\. Identify and manage legal and security risks, together with the Director, security, program and other colleagues as appropriate in line with organizational policies;



12\. Travel domestically and internationally, as required for internal meetings, research missions, and advocacy opportunities; and



13\. Undertake other responsibilities as required.


**Management Responsibilities:**  

1\. Manage and guide staff in conjunction with the Director to deliver timely, high\-quality work that supports EESR's strategy and priorities;



2\. Lead, motivate and mentor staff by setting clear expectations, providing regular and constructive feedback, supporting balanced workloads and professional growth, and monitoring staff well\-being;



3\. Promote and inclusive, creative and positive work environment by soliciting diverse perspectives, modeling inclusive behavior and adhering to HRW's values;



4\. Provide appropriate and timely feedback on staff performance and guidance, coaching and training, as necessary;



5\. Contribute to putting in place systems, processes, and policies to ensure the efficient functioning of the team and its ability to manage projects and budgets and deliver timely outputs;


**Candidate Profile**



The successful candidate will be a thoughtful, collaborative, and strategic leader with deep knowledge and experience working on human rights issues related to health, labor, social security and the environment. They will have experience of conducting on\-the\-ground investigative human rights research, as well as managing researchers. They will be a persuasive advocate with a strong track record of driving change, building equitable partnerships, and shaping HRW's contribution to the global human rights movement.



They will be an experienced manager who communicates effectively across teams, builds consensus around key challenges and new research and advocacy approaches, comfortable managing experienced staff, and upholds the highest research standards in a culture of learning, trust, teamwork, and collaboration. They will be someone who operates from a place of principle and inclusive leadership.



They will champion health, labor and social security work throughout the organization, clearly explain technical concepts in plain language, and communicate the human rights dimensions of this work to internal and external audiences.


**Qualifications**


**Education:** A graduate degree or an equivalent level of experience in a field related to economic, social and cultural rights or environment and human rights is required.


**Experience:** A minimum of seven (7\) years of relevant work experience overseeing research and advocacy on issues related to ESC rights including health, labor, social security, and/or the environment and human rights, with at least four years in a management role, is required. Experience managing in a large organization is an additional benefit.

  

**Related Skills and Knowledge**



1\. Deep knowledge of and experience working on health, labor, social security and the environment using the international human rights framework is required.



2\. Demonstrated experience developing and implementing impact\-driven human rights research and advocacy projects, including firsthand experience conducting on\-the\-ground human rights investigations and track record of publications is required.



3\. Management experience, including supervising a team of researchers, ideally in multiple locations, and proven experience supporting direct reports to update substantive knowledge and research skills is required.



4\. Track record of measurable success executing complex projects, managing budgets, implementing operational change, conducting monitoring and evaluation, and ensuring high\-quality deliverables is required.



5\. Excellent oral and written communication skills in English are required. Fluency in a second language is a plus.



6\. Strong and consistent editor of a range of written work products, with the ability to edit for factual and legal accuracy, structure, clarity, audience, gender analysis, grammar and length is required.



7\. Strong interpersonal skills to work collaboratively within HRW, as well as develop constructive relationships with NGOs, media, research institutes, multilateral organizations, governments, academia, and the private sector are required.



8\. Capacity to plan, prioritize and manage multiple competing demands, adjust to changing priorities, and meet deadlines in a challenging, fast\-paced environment is required.



9\. Optimism, collegiality, willingness to experience and learn from mistakes, and patience and persistence in building effective ways of working in an established organization are required.



10\. Demonstrated commitment to high standards of accuracy, objectivity, creativity, and ethics is required.



11\. Demonstrated awareness and sensitivity to the needs and concerns of individuals from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and orientations is required.



12\. Ability to work collaboratively and respectfully with others in multicultural teams, across organizational boundaries and multiple time zones, and with employees at all levels is required.


**Salary and Benefits**: Human Rights Watch offers competitive salaries and comprehensive employer\-paid benefits. HRW offers a relocation assistance package and where possible will assist employees in obtaining necessary work authorization, if required; citizens of all nationalities are encouraged to apply. If based in the United States, the salary range is USD 121,000 \- 133,000\. If based in Canada, the salary range is CAD 152,000 \- 167,000\. Salary ranges outside of the United States and Canada vary based on location and are not a direct translation from USD.


**How to Apply**: Please apply immediately or by October 6, 2026, by visiting our online job portal at careers.hrw.org and attaching a cover letter and a resume or CV. No calls or email inquiries, please. Applications must be complete to receive consideration, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



If you are experiencing technical difficulties with your application submission, or if you require accommodations during the application process, please email recruitment@hrw.org. Due to the large response, application submissions via email will not be accepted and inquiries regarding the status of applications will go unanswered.


***Human Rights Watch is strong because it is diverse.*** *We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Human Rights Watch does not discriminate on the basis of disability, age, gender identity and expression, national origin, race and ethnicity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, or criminal record. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Our employees include people who are parents and nonparents, the self\-taught and university educated, and from a wide span of socio\-economic backgrounds and perspectives on the world. Human Rights Watch is an equal opportunity employer.*


***Human Rights Watch*** *is an international human rights research and advocacy organization known for its in\-depth investigations, its incisive and timely reporting, its innovative and high\-profile advocacy campaigns, and its success in changing the human rights\-related policies and practices of governments and international institutions.*

title: Marketing & Account Manager
description:
### **About Us**


WheelHouse Online is the digital marketing agency division of WheelHouse IT, an established managed IT services provider. We build and redesign WordPress websites and run ongoing SEO, social media, blogging, and digital strategy programs for clients in healthcare, legal, construction, insurance, non\-profit, and the broader SMB market.


Being part of a managed IT services company makes us unusual. Our clients get a marketing partner with real technical depth behind it, and our team gets exposure to both sides of the business.

*Transforming Businesses One Click at a Time.*

### **The Role**


This is a hybrid strategy and relationship role sitting at the intersection of our agency and our parent company.


You will lead a portfolio of agency clients as their strategic marketing partner, and you will also run WheelHouse IT itself as an internal anchor account, managed under a formal Statement of Work with the same rigor we give our highest paying external clients.


You will have one direct report, a Digital Marketing Coordinator, and you will direct the day to day work of our external execution partner. You report to the Director of Marketing and work as a peer to our Lead Web Developer.


If you like owning outcomes rather than executing someone else's plan, this role has room to run.

### **Where You'll Work**


You choose:

* **Hybrid, Fort Lauderdale.** Three days in our Fort Lauderdale office, two days wherever you work best. The days out are your choice, not a fixed schedule we assign you.
* **Fully remote, anywhere in the US.** No relocation required.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Lead client accounts.** Own the strategy, the relationship, and the results for a portfolio of agency clients. Be the person they call.
* **Run WheelHouse IT as an anchor account.** Manage our own brand's marketing deliverables under a formal internal SOW, with the same discipline you would apply to a paying client.
* **Run the monthly reporting meeting.** Present traffic by source (including traffic from AI and LLM referrals), top pages, time on page, engagement, and form fills. Show up with a recommendation, not just a chart.
* **Manage and mentor.** Direct the Digital Marketing Coordinator. Set their priorities, review their work, and help them grow.
* **Direct our execution partner.** Brief deliverables, set priorities, and quality check output before it reaches a client.
* **Partner with our Lead Web Developer.** Make sure campaigns, landing pages, and funnels are supported by strong technical execution, and that web builds have demand pointed at them.
* **Spot opportunities to help clients further.** When a client mentions an IT or cybersecurity problem on a strategy call, you will have the option to introduce them to the WheelHouse IT team. Introductions that turn into business earn you an additional bonus.
* **Own our earned media pipeline.** We have a system that surfaces inbound journalist and media inquiries. You will own the process of reviewing them, identifying the ones where WheelHouse IT has something worth saying, and turning those into earned coverage. This is earned media, not paid placement.
* **Report up.** Roll campaign and demand generation metrics into a clear monthly view for leadership.

### **What You Bring**

**Required**

* 3\-5 years in digital marketing, agency account management, or B2B in\-house marketing
* Direct experience owning client or stakeholder relationships and presenting performance results
* Hands\-on HubSpot experience
* Working knowledge of WordPress and Elementor, enough to scope work, brief a developer, and quality check a page (you do not need to build sites yourself)
* Fluency in GA4 and Google Search Console, and the ability to turn what you see there into a recommendation someone can act on
* Practical, daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar) to increase your output and quality. We expect this, we do not just tolerate it.
* Strong writing and editing skills, and comfort adapting to a professional B2B voice
* The organization to run multiple accounts on parallel timelines without dropping deliverables

**Preferred**

* Experience managing or mentoring a direct report or contractor
* Background in MSP, IT services, SaaS, or another technical B2B category
* SEO tooling experience (Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz)
* Paid social or paid search campaign management
* Agency\-side experience working within SOWs and managing scope

### **Compensation**

**$65,000 \- $70,000 OTE in year one, with uncapped growth.**

* **Base salary:** $55,000 \- $60,000, depending on experience
* **Retention commission:** paid quarterly on the active clients in your portfolio. Uncapped.
* **Cross\-sell bonus:** additional earnings when a client you introduce to WheelHouse IT becomes a customer.


This is a residual structure, not an annual discretionary bonus. Retain and grow your book and your earnings grow with it, without waiting for a review cycle. We will walk you through exactly how it works when we talk.

### **Benefits**

**Health and financial security**

* Medical, dental, and optical insurance
* Life insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching contributions

**Time and flexibility**

* Paid time off
* 7 paid holidays
* Work from home flexibility
* Company\-issued smartphone, so you are never covering business use on a personal plan

**Growth and culture**

* Company\-provided training to build new skills and advance your career
* Sunset Seminars, our casual after\-hours learning sessions
* Quarterly team building events

### **Why This Role**


You will sit on our leadership tier with a direct report, a real client portfolio, and a seat at the table with our Director of Marketing and Lead Web Developer. You will see both the agency side and the managed IT side of an established business that is still expanding, which is a combination most marketing roles cannot offer.

### **How to Apply**


Apply through this posting. Please include a link to work samples, a portfolio, or a client report you are proud of.
