title: Midweight Creative (Copywriter)
description:
**We are Wiser,** a global, award\-winning Employer Brand agency.


We build employer brands to guide the best in the biz into their dream career with our clients.  

We’re a home for people who think big and expect more. We transform a company’s employer brand internally and externally and change cultures from the ground up.
  

  

With creative, strategic and early talent experts in\-house, our clients have a single partnership with Wiser and we deliver end to end campaigns helping them to attract and retain the best talent globally.  

  

We believe that people will do their best work when they're in a space that enables it. And that's what we've shaped at Wiser \- a culture where everyone can be real and back themselves, surrounded by high performers who take ownership of their career and make moves, no matter what their background.  

  

To find out more about us, take a look at our website wearewiser.com  

or check us out on Instagram @wearewiser.

##### **What's this role all about?**


Our Creative team sits at the heart of Wiser. We’re a group of generalists who ideate, copywrite and art direct as the brief requires. We come up with our biggest ideas, support tactical campaigns and turn research\-backed strategy and insights into creative that moves candidates and employees to action.


For this role, we’re looking for a Creative who is ideas first, but whose strongest craft is copy. Someone who can find the thought, articulate it simply and bring it to life through everything from a three\-word headline to a film script or full campaign.

##### **What will you spend your time doing?**

* Owning creative outputs across multiple global and nationwide accounts, often moving between very different brands, audiences and briefs
* Turning insights and strategy into strong creative concepts, then developing them across campaigns, social, film, activations and other channels
* Using copy as one of your strongest creative tools – writing everything from campaign lines and social copy to scripts, manifestos and longer\-form website and brochure copy
* Working alongside designers, filmmakers, strategists and account teams to bring ideas to life, contributing to the visual direction even when you’re not the person designing it
* Creating topical content that taps into global events, cultural moments and trends, working at speed when the opportunity calls for it
* Getting under the skin of different brands and their guidelines, then finding ways to develop their employer brand and creative world over time
* Confidently share and present your thinking, advocating for smart, brave creative that drives measurable results
* Learning from campaign performance and social engagement, using what works to make the next piece of creative even better

##### **What are we looking for?**

* 2\.5\+ years of experience in a creative role, either in\-house or at an agency
* A conceptual creative brain, with a particular strength and passion for copywriting
* A portfolio that shows strong ideas and the ability to bring them to life
* Confidence writing across formats, from punchy headlines and social copy to film scripts and longer\-form storytelling
* A good visual instinct and the ability to collaborate with designers to shape how an idea comes to life
* An interest in culture, human behaviour and what makes people think, feel and act

##### **What's in it for you?**

* Work from Anywhere \- everyone has a number of days to work from home or wherever they fancy. Whether it’s staying home to snuggle your cat or working from Greece for a week in the summer, WFA is the answer.

Whether it’s how to craft the perfect deck with our Creative Director, how to speak confidently about commercials with our CFO, or get some tips on managing for the first time with our Head of People, the schedule has something for everyone
* Therapy \- with 5 therapists to choose from, each year you can get up to x3 therapy sessions subsidised through Wiser to take either here in our own secret Log Cabin, externally or online (you pay £20 a session and we cover the rest)

* Gymbox \- once passing probation, you can access our exclusive Wiser x Gymbox partnership where you can bag your Gymbox membership for less than half price.

##### **The Road to Wiser...**

* Apply (Go on... do it)

* Video call w/ the hiring manager

At Wiser, we’re committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels empowered to be themselves and inspired to excel. We know that true creativity and innovation thrive when diversity is celebrated and everyone is given equal access to opportunities. That’s why we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or socioeconomic status.  

  

We believe that everyone should feel comfortable and be able to back themselves in an inclusive environment where individuality is celebrated. We’re building a team as diverse as the brands we work with, and our aim is to change the way people think about work.  

  

If you’re passionate about making meaningful moves in an environment that’s as inclusive as it is high\-performing, we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to Wiser. Feel free to reach out to our Talent Team if you need any adjustments to make our hiring process more accessible.

title: Studio X Chief Designer
description:
**Job Description**
 We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.
   

  

 Join us in shaping the future of Ford Motor Company, as part of a global organization with exceptional colleagues in world\-class facilities. As part of
 **Ford Design** 
 , you’ll be at the cutting edge of Ford’s most strategically critical work, designing people and society’s needs into the heart of our next generation of products, services, and experiences.
   

  

***The Studio X Digital Design Chief reports to the Director of Design Operations and leads Design Visualization, Research \& Development, and Digital Technologies globally. This leader defines the strategic digital roadmap for the Global Design organization while ensuring operational excellence, rigorous data security, and high\-performing team management.***
**Responsibilities**
**What you'll do...**
**Strategic Leadership \& Digital Transformation**
* Digital Roadmap: Define and execute a long\-term global digital support strategy and transformation roadmap to enhance creativity and efficiency across Global Design.
* Emerging Tech \& AI: Evaluate and implement emerging digital tools, including AI, procedural workflow automation, and immersive technologies (AR/VR/MR).
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner with Program teams, Engineering, IT, Corporate Security, and Marketing to align digital initiatives with brand vision and future product strategies.


**Digital Production \& Visualization**
* End\-to\-End Pipelines: Oversee high\-fidelity rendering, narrative animation, real\-time visualization, and immersive digital simulation pipelines.
* Media Services: Manage comprehensive photography (including drone and documentary) and professional videography/editing services for the Design studio.
* Quality \& Delivery: Establish and enforce rigorous quality standards and review processes to ensure on\-time delivery of all Studio X assets.
* Executive Presentation: Support Marketing and Strategy teams with Executive Leadership Team (ELT) presentations and Market Research stimuli; confidently pitch and facilitate project reviews for senior leadership.


**Operations, Budget, \& IT Asset Management**
* Hardware Lifecycle: Manage procurement, maintenance, and lifecycles for high\-performance workstations, AR/VR head\-mounted displays, MicroLED displays, printers, and data management systems.
* Software \& SaaS: Oversee software licensing, SaaS usage, vendor negotiations, enterprise agreements, and corporate compliance.
* ROI Optimization: Ensure maximum ROI on all hardware and software acquisitions through pipeline automation and licensing efficiencies.


**Data Governance \& Studio Security**
* IP Protection: Implement data governance and security protocols for design imagery and highly sensitive, pre\-production data.
* Access Control: Create, implement, and enforce strict physical access\-control policies for all secure design studios and spaces.


**People Leadership \& Talent Development**
* Culture \& Performance: Foster a highly collaborative, accountable, and engaged studio culture. Lead OKR/KPI development and performance management.
* HR \& Personnel Management: Assist the Design Operations Director with personnel programs, including performance reviews, salary planning, employee counseling, and training plans.
* Mentorship \& Coaching: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, and mentor team members through complex, ambiguous challenges.


**Qualifications**
**You'll have...**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Transportation Design, Industrial Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 10\+ years in Automotive Design, high\-end product visualization, or digital design (in\-studio program experience preferred).
* Project Management: Proven experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder multimedia projects and budgets.
* Technical Expertise: Extensive knowledge of modern digital tools, hardware, data governance, IP protection, and the overall Product Development/Design process.
* Leadership: Strong business acumen with demonstrated leadership skills in hiring, developing, and inspiring creative technical teams.


**Even better, you may have...**
* Prior experience working within large, complex corporate environments and creative cultures.
* Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and global automotive design trends.
* Proven track record of presenting to and influencing executive\-level audiences.


 You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

 As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
   

  

* Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
* Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up child care and more
* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
* Tuition assistance
* Established and active employee resource groups
* Paid time off for individual and team community service
* A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
* Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.


 This position is leadership level 5 and ranges from $141,700\-$268,300\.
   

  

 Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.
   

  

 For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/LL5
   

  

 Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

 Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\.
   

  

 This position is hybrid with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week.

title: Director Design, Product Design & AI (m/f/d)
description:
#### **This is Edenspiekermann**


We are Edenspiekermann, an independent design consultancy with 40\+ years of experience helping world\-leading organizations invent, build, and evolve their products.


Our interaction designers work in agile and interdisciplinary teams on websites and platforms for major brands as well as for startups. Our teams combine conceptual thinking, a sophisticated understanding of design and a deep knowledge of web and app development to develop a digital product or service with a user\-centric approach. In doing so, we advise and coach our clients' teams to provide the best customer experience for their customers.

#### **Description**


We are looking for a hands\-on Design Director to join our US team in a permanent, remote\-first role based in Southern California. You will work primarily from home and be available to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require. You will lead complex digital\-product and design\-system engagements across our portfolio, including work in regulated industries and global medical technology. AI will be a core part of how you explore, prototype, make decisions, and help teams deliver better work.  

This is a senior client\-facing role for someone who is excited by how AI is changing design and product development. You will set direction, stay close to the work, and help clients move from isolated experiments to useful AI\-enabled products, workflows, and operating models. You will combine curiosity and speed with strong judgment about where human craft, review, and accountability matter.

#### **Your Tasks**

* Lead client engagements end\-to\-end, from initial framing and design direction through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Translate user needs, business goals, brand intent, accessibility, engineering, content, and compliance requirements into clear product and system direction.
* Own the design quality of the work, balancing strategic clarity with strong visual, interaction, and systems\-design craft.
* Direct the creation and evolution of scalable Figma libraries, component architectures, variables, tokens, themes, patterns, prototypes, and documentation.
* Work closely with product and engineering leaders to connect design decisions with production code, release processes, and measurable product outcomes.
* Establish practical governance and contribution models that support distributed teams without overloading a small central group.
* Facilitate workshops and decision\-making with senior stakeholders across design, product, engineering, research, content, and compliance.
* Guide multidisciplinary teams, coach designers, set a high bar for craft, and give clear, constructive direction.
* Make AI part of the design practice every day, using it for research synthesis, ideation, content, prototyping, design\-system work, and design\-to\-code exploration.
* Prototype AI\-enabled product experiences, including conversational, adaptive, generative, and agentic interactions, then test whether they create meaningful value for people.
* Experiment quickly with new tools and models, share what works, and help the team build repeatable AI workflows instead of one\-off demos.
* Evaluate AI output critically and establish practical guardrails for quality, accessibility, privacy, approved source material, human review, and accountability.
* Help shape Edenspiekermann's AI\-enabled product and design\-systems practice, contributing to how we pitch, deliver, and talk about the work.
#### **Your profile**

* You have at least 8 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or design systems, including several years leading complex client or enterprise engagements.
* Your portfolio demonstrates systems thinking, refined visual craft, shipped digital products, and credible AI\-enabled work.
* You have led design systems across multiple products, platforms, brands, or teams and understand how they connect to Figma libraries, production code, documentation, versioning, and engineering adoption.
* You have experience in a regulated or high\-accountability environment and treat accessibility as a system requirement.
* You can lead senior client conversations, facilitate difficult decisions, and turn ambiguity into a practical path forward with curiosity, judgment, and a collaborative, low\-ego attitude.
* You actively use generative and agentic AI in your own practice, can demonstrate workflows beyond surface\-level prompting, and can separate useful applications from hype.
* You communicate fluently in English and are comfortable collaborating across US and European teams.
* You are based in Southern California, willing and able to travel to client sites across the United States as engagements require, and legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
#### **We Offer**

* A permanent, full\-time, remote\-first role with a central place in our US design team.
* The annual salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
* A defined contribution toward medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus access to a healthcare FSA.
* A 401(k) plan with a 2% company match and eligibility for a discretionary year\-end bonus based on company performance.
* A flexible PTO policy, with time off coordinated around client and team commitments, plus eleven paid holidays, a year\-end office closure, monthly internet and wellness stipends, and professional\-development support.
* The opportunity to lead visible, strategically important product, design\-system, and AI\-enabled transformation engagements.
* An international portfolio and regular collaboration with colleagues across Europe and the United States.
* A high\-craft, low\-ego team with direct access to partners and senior leadership, real autonomy, constructive feedback, and space to shape how we work.
* A multidisciplinary team that is actively building AI into design, strategy, research, engineering, and delivery.
#### **We are pleased to meet you!**


We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/beliefs, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity.

**If you are interested, please provide us with the following documents and information:**

* Current CV
* Portfolio with at least one substantial product or design\-system case and a credible AI\-enabled product or workflow example
* A short explanation of your role, decisions, measurable contribution, and how AI changed the work or outcome
* Earliest possible start date


One more thing, never fear to apply initiative. We understand: a lack of confidence can sometimes keep us from applying for a job. But guess what?! There is no such thing as the perfect applicant. That's why we encourage you to apply to us.

title: Brand ambassador (video content) & community — Fitune LATAM
description:
* **Format:** 
 Part\-time or full\-time
* **Location:** 
 Mexico City. Remote day\-to\-day, with in\-person studio visits in CDMX 2\-3 times a month
* **Language:**



 \- Native or fluent Spanish required.
 



 \- Professional English for internal communication
 



 \- Portuguese is a plus
 



  





  





**\-\-What's Fitune** 




 Fitune is the intelligent operating system for fitness and wellness studios.
 



 Studios across Latin America run their business on complicated software or manual processes. We built Fitune so that running and growing a studio is easier and more profitable: a conversion\-optimised website and app, booking, in\-person classes, events, courses and 1\-on\-1s, automated payments and subscriptions, client and business management, and more.
 



 Fitune launched in 2021 and now serves hundreds of studios processing more than a quarter of a million bookings a month, with a 30\-person team across Mexico, Colombia, Chile and Brazil. We aim to grow past 3,000 studios in 2027\.
 



  





 Our product in action
 


* Example studio website: https://www.myfitune.io/playhardgym
* On\-demand demo: https://www.fitune.io/watch\-demo
* Our website: www.fitune.io



  





**\-\-The role** 




 We are looking for the on\-camera face of Fitune in Latin America: a senior creator who is active in the fitness world, genuinely energetic, and happiest when they are in a studio talking to the people who run it.
 



 This person owns the relationship between Fitune and the community around it — studio owners, coaches, and the people who train in those studios. They visit to studios, interview owners, film sessions and events, create challenges and activations, and turn all of it into content that studio owners want to watch and share.
 



 It is a hands\-on role. You concept it, you present it, you film it, you edit it, you publish it, and you answer the comments.
 



 In short: you help turn Fitune into the most valuable brand for fitness studio owners in LATAM.
 



  





**\-\-What you'll do: On\-ground execution and community building** 




 Visit to top studios to interview owners, cover live training sessions and events, and capture testimonials. Create challenges and activations that bring studios and their communities into the Fitune orbit. Build real relationships with partner studios, coaches, and end users — the kind where people text you before they text support.
 



  





**\-\-Premium video production** 




 Own video end to end, from concept to published cut. Short\-form and long\-form, both edited to a standard that matches a premium brand. You are comfortable being the only person on set.
 



  





**\-\-Product representation** 




 Star in and produce product videos that translate technical features into content people actually finish watching. You make software feel useful and human.
 



  





**\-\-Be the face of Fitune Academy** 




 You are the image of Fitune Academy, our educational platform for fitness and wellness studios. You present the courses, tutorials and masterclasses that teach owners and coaches how to run and grow their business, and over time your face becomes the one people associate with learning at Fitune. That means holding a consistent on\-camera identity across every lesson, keeping the material clear and practical rather than promotional, and working with product and marketing to decide what the community needs to learn next.
 



  





**\-\-Channel and community management** 




 Manage day\-to\-day publishing across Facebook (including Facebook groups like Pilates coaches groups, etc) , Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn. Own the content calendar, adapt formats per platform, optimise captions and descriptions, monitor performance, and reply to comments and DMs so the community stays responsive.
 



  





**\-\-Content strategy and growth** 




 Work with marketing, product and sales to turn launches into content, share studio success stories, educate owners on growing their business, test new formats, and improve performance based on what the numbers say.
 



  





**\-\-AI\-accelerated workflow** 




 Use generative AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, plus video and audio automation) to move faster on scripting, brainstorming, social listening and post\-production.
 



  





**\-\-Authenticity safeguard** 




 Know exactly where AI efficiency ends and human connection begins. Every final script, cut and comment reply should feel organic and specific to the culture of the fitness community it is speaking to.
 



  





**\-\-Types of content you'll create** 




**Short\-form social content** 



* https://www.instagram.com/p/DVObFk\-Ebut/
* https://www.instagram.com/p/DU500q7DlVb/
* https://www.instagram.com/p/DS3CieVDkSa/



**Long\-form interviews with studio owners** 



* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=XP8gSAU8Ndk
* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=hJEQtnxjU9k



**Educational, tutorial and webinar content** 



* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=XnsxSHQefvk



 Plus Fitune Academy videos, product feature highlights, event coverage, community challenges and activations.
 



 \-\-
 



  





**Who you are** 



* You are active in the fitness or wellness world. You train, you know the vocabulary, you understand what a studio owner's Monday looks like.
* Your energy is the point. You are warm, enthusiastic, and inviting on camera and off it, and people relax around you.
* You love making things. High standards on craft, and you would rather reshoot than publish something you are not proud of.
* You genuinely enjoy people. Meeting them, interviewing them, remembering their names, building something they want to be part of.
* You are hands\-on and autonomous. You pitch your own hooks, run your own days, and do not need a producer to get something shipped.
* You are comfortable in a room with a high\-profile studio owner and equally comfortable with the coaches and members on the floor.
* You are curious and constantly generating ideas.



 \-\-Skills and experience
 



  





**Must have** 



* Proven experience creating video content for social media
* Comfortable presenting on camera as the face of a brand
* Experience with short\-form content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)
* Ability to film and edit your own content end to end, short and long form
* Strong storytelling for digital platforms
* Strong understanding of social media trends and formats
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the confidence to network with business owners



  





**Technical skills** 



* Video editing tools
* Basic design tools (Canva, Figma)
* Camera and lighting basics
* Social media publishing and scheduling tools
* Generative AI tools for scripting, ideation and post\-production



  





**Language** 



* Native or fluent Spanish. Content will be in Spanish
* Professional English for internal communication



  





**Bonus points** 



* Background working in fitness, wellness or sports
* Experience producing interview\-style content
* Experience creating educational or tutorial content
* Experience growing a social media audience from a standing start
* Existing network among studio owners or coaches in Mexico



 \-\-What success looks like
 



**First 30 days.** 
 You have visited your first studios, published your first short\-form pieces, and know the product well enough to demo it on camera.
 



**First 90 days.** 
 A consistent publishing rhythm across channels, a recognisable on\-camera presence, the first long\-form interviews live, and a growing set of studio relationships.
 



**First 6 months.** 
 Measurable growth in audience and engagement, a repeatable content engine, and a community where studio owners and coaches participate rather than just watch.
 



  





**\-\-Location and logistics** 



* Based in Mexico City
* Day\-to\-day work is remote
* In\-person studio visits and interviews in CDMX 2\-3 times a month, support in events and other activations, plus occasional travel to other markets



 \-\-Hours and format
 



 This role can be part\-time or full\-time depending on the person and their other commitments. Tell us in your application which you are looking for and what your availability looks like.
 



  





**\-\-How to apply** 




 Think you'd be a great fit for this position at Fitune?
 



 Fill out our job application form here
 



  




* **Include a link to content you have made and appear in. A reel, a channel, a client project — whatever shows us how you are on camera.**

title: Head of Education
location: Gustavo A. Madero, Mexico City, Mexico
description:
****About Us****
 Platzi is the largest technology school in the Hispanic world with over 7 million students and 4,000 companies trusting us to deliver effective online education. Our mission is to make Latin America a technology superpower. We do it by training companies and individuals in areas such as AI, Cybersecurity, English, Programming and Leadership.
   

  

 As an industry leader, our presence is highlighted by our massive and fanatic community, extensive press coverage and a daily stream of success stories from students. We operate mostly remote, with key offices in Bogotá, Medellín and Mexico City.
   

  

****Summary****
 As Head of Education at Platzi, you own the content engine and the team behind it: the Course Directors, the Postproduction Manager (who leads the editors). You own the content strategy end\-to\-end and you keep the whole system running. You report to the CPO.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on builder's role. You're a head, but you live in the operation and the detail. You code and ship tools, and you've already learned what Platzi needs to teach now, that's what lets you judge whether content is good and see where it should go next. You don't just decide what we teach; you design the strategy, read market demand, and shape a catalog that makes sense for Platzi and gives Growth an engine that works. And you back it with data.
   

  

****Requirements****
**Responsibilities**
* Lead the Education team: Course Directors, the Postproduction Manager (who leads the editors), and the partnerships lead.
* Design the content strategy: read market demand and Platzi's fit to decide what we teach and why.
* Own the content roadmap: decide what we build, in what order, and why.
* Own content quality: set the standard for a great course and go to the root cause when it's not met.
* Keep the system running end\-to\-end: production, postproduction, and publishing, on time and at quality.
* Build, don't just manage: ship internal tools, including AI, that scale how we produce and improve courses.
* Own the numbers: retention, acquisition, and enrollments per course and plan launches with Growth Marketing so the catalog drives results.


****Requirements****
* At least 7 years of experience, including leading a team with direct reports.
* You can code, and you've already built at least one tool with AI.
* You understand how to create content: you've made courses or educational content yourself.
* You've used metrics to make decisions: retention, acquisition, enrollments, or a similar funnel.
* Experience in startups or fast\-moving environments, close to new ways of learning.
* Fluent English and Spanish.


****Benefits****
 Hardware
   

  

 With Platzi's help, you will have 100% of the necessary work tools such as a laptop, smartphone, desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, and other accessories.
   

  

 Books
   

  

 We provide you with all the books you need to grow professionally on Kindle, and we give you the Kindle too .
   

  

 Maternity/Paternity Leave
   

  

 At Platzi, we believe in gender equity and the importance of parents in the upbringing and care of their children. We make this a reality for new mothers and fathers through extended maternity and paternity leave.
   

  

 Option Pool
   

  

 All members of the Platzi Team have the opportunity to own a part of Platzi and have company shares.
   

  

 Vacation
   

  

 You have 15 days of vacation per year regardless of the country you are in, starting from the moment you join the team.
   

  

 ‍♂️ Online Therapy
   

  

 We care about your emotional health by covering the first four online therapy sessions with specialized companies.
   

  

 Team Syncs
   

  

 Although we are in different parts of the world, Platzi teams meet in person during the year to exchange ideas, build, and strengthen bonds.
   

  

 ️ Villa Platzi
   

  

 Every year, the entire team gathers somewhere in the world for a week to meet face\-to\-face, get to know each other, have interesting discussions, and plan ambitious projects.

title: Country Manager, Argentina
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**Company Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Where and how you can work**
 Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. Since we don’t have a physical campus in Argentina, this role is fully remote—giving you the flexibility to do your best work from wherever you thrive.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

**At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On**
* Strategy. Act as the main leadership point of contact with responsibility for overall user and revenue growth in Argentina. You'll bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, product, content and finance to create and execute a cohesive multi\-year growth strategy, and own the KPIs including MAUs and ARR.
* Localisation. Work closely with the regional team to optimise our product, content, pricing and packaging to meet the needs of local users, informed by a deep understanding of local market dynamics and cultural nuances across a range of audiences, including knowledge workers, SMBs, students, startup ecosystems, NGOs, and other emerging sectors.
* Leadership. Hire, inspire, drive and in some cases coach the in\-market team, ensuring a high quality bar for impact and working closely with local speciality leads on performance management.
* Budget. Partner closely with the regional team and marketing lead to shape the marketing strategy and deployment of budget.
* Sponsorship. Build and support high value relationships by acting as a local sponsor for enterprise sales, education, government, partnerships, etc.
* Public face. Represent Canva as a local figurehead across press, PR, events and community.


**You're probably a match if**
* You are strongly entrepreneurial. Founder\-style appetite for growing something big from a small start and working across everything from education to press.
* You possess experience growing a market. For example, as the regional GM or brand lead for a global SaaS company, or as a proven founder or growth lead in a startup in a high growth environment.
* You are a proven leader. Ability to grow, inspire, and coach high\-performing teams. You have high emotional intelligence and empathy, and are a deeply collaborative teammate.
* You are a strong communicator. Fully proficient in spoken and written English, and with the interpersonal skills to influence global and local stakeholders.
* You are keenly analytical. Deeply focused on KPIs and obsessive about driving actionable insights from disparate datasets and able to think about a market’s performance holistically.
* you are product oriented. Passion for improving the experience of users and the ability to translate local insights into product requirements with experience localising a global product for a particular market.
* You are values aligned. Genuinely excited by Canva’s mission and deeply aligned with our values, and with exceptional references to prove it.
* You are publicity savvy. Experience doing public speaking and acting as a public face to the press and other stakeholders.
* You are well networked. Ideally with routes into some combination of government departments, corporates, influencers, journalists and local talent


**About The Team**
 Canva’s International supergroup is a diverse, distributed team of marketers, strategists, and growth leaders focused on expanding Canva's presence in key global markets. Our team partners with functions across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, Partnerships, Content, Finance, and Strategy to drive sustainable user and revenue growth in international markets.
   

  

 As the Country Manager for Argentina, you will be the main point of contact and the driving force behind Canva’s success in the country. You will own and implement a multi\-year strategic roadmap, leading cross\-functional efforts to grow the user base and scale revenue.
   

  

 This role requires deep market knowledge, a growth mindset, and strong leadership capabilities to bring together local and global teams across marketing, sales, and product in a cohesive strategy.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**

title: GenAI Creator

description:

 At Pencil, we are building the AI Operating System for marketing \- the only enterprise platform that aggregates every leading AI model, enforces enterprise\-grade governance, and turns creative production savings into media growth.  Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI.  You work day\-to\-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands\-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision \- you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.

title: Country Manager Argentina y Uruguay
description:

* Excel intermedio

title: GENERAL MANAGER / MANAGING DIRECTOR Savvy Smart Deals

 **THE ROLE**  

Savvy Smart Deals is looking for a senior operator to **run the business end to end**.

* Own revenue, margin, profit, budgets and forecasts

* Ensure every major product and channel has clear economics

* Negotiate payouts and commercial terms
* Secure profitable traffic at scale

* Prevent stockouts and excessive inventory
* Improve use of existing inventory through new offers, bundles and upsells

**Performance \& Analytics**

* Revenue

* ROAS
* RPC
* CVR
* AOV
* Affiliate payouts
* Payment approval rates
* Refunds and chargebacks
* Inventory levels
* Recurring revenue
* Customer lifetime value
  


This is a data\-driven role. Decisions should be based on economics, not opinion.

 **Leadership**

  

* Lead the Savvy business and operating team
* Set priorities, owners and deadlines
* Hold teams accountable for results
* Coordinate sourcing, creative, marketing, technology, analytics, finance and operations
* Recruit and develop strong people
* Remove roadblocks and keep execution moving

  

  

**WHO WE WANT**  

We are looking for a proven **owner\-type operator**, not a corporate administrator.

  

You should have meaningful experience running or scaling an e\-commerce, DTC, consumer\-products or performance\-marketing business.

  

Strong candidates will have:


* Senior leadership experience
* Direct P\&L responsibility
* Experience launching and scaling products
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills
* Strong understanding of performance and affiliate marketing
* Experience with Shopify and direct\-response e\-commerce
* Strong financial and analytical ability
* Experience managing marketing budgets
* Understanding of sourcing, inventory and supply\-chain economics
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams
* Excellent English
* Strong technology and AI skills

  

  

Experience with international e\-commerce, Asian sourcing, Amazon, recurring\-revenue models and payment optimization is a strong advantage.

We want someone who can:


* Make decisions
* Move quickly
* Negotiate hard
* Understand numbers
* Challenge weak assumptions
* Find opportunities
* Solve problems
* Lead people
* Take responsibility for results

  

  

You should be comfortable moving from a supplier negotiation to a P\&L review, then to a marketing campaign, traffic negotiation or inventory issue in the same day.

  

This role will not suit someone who waits for detailed instructions or manages mainly through meetings.

 **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**  

Success means building Savvy Smart Deals into a larger, more profitable and better\-run global e\-commerce business with:


* Strong new products
* Profitable traffic
* Faster launches
* Better conversion
* Higher AOV
* Growing recurring revenue
* Strong inventory management
* Accurate forecasting
* Clear accountability
* Consistent testing and optimization
* Increasing revenue and profit

  

  

**WHY JOIN**  

This is a rare opportunity to **run an entire business**, not one department.

  

You will have significant authority, direct access to ownership, strong internal resources and meaningful performance\-based upside.

  

If you have already built, operated or scaled an e\-commerce business and want full responsibility for the outcome, we want to speak with you.

title: Interior Design Associate Director
description:
TGP International is looking for an experienced and highly creative Senior Associate / Associate Director to join its studio.

  

TGP International is a global hospitality consultancy based in London, Dubai, and Cairo. We partner with ambitious brands, clients, and entrepreneurs to turn their visions into successful hospitality experiences through concept development, interior design, branding and graphic design, advisory, franchising, operations, and project management. Our multidisciplinary team brings together interior designers, brand designers, strategists, advisors, chefs, and hospitality operators. We are looking for someone who shares that passion. Someone inspired by the opportunity to create world\-class restaurants, bars, food halls, and hospitality destinations, and who understands how exceptional design can transform the guest experience.

  

While TGP is an established international consultancy, we retain a strong entrepreneurial spirit. This is a senior role within our Interior Design team, offering significant studio responsibility, client exposure, and the opportunity to contribute directly to exciting hospitality projects.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Design Expertise**

* Deliver world class creative solutions across multiple small, medium, and large\-scale projects simultaneously, and across multiple geographies (UK, Europe, Asia and Middle East)
* Lead projects and the creative process from concept to delivery; with proven track record of strong design narrative where storytelling remains at the heart of the project throughout its development
* Lead and contribute hands\-on to concept development and design presentations, test fits, spatial planning, and 3D models, with a strong focus on guest experience and operational functionality
* Review detailed drawing packages, finishes and FF\&E specifications ensuring technical requirements and design intent are successfully co\-ordinated, including liaising effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and suppliers throughout the design and delivery process
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of design detailing, materials, finishes, fixtures and furniture, including fabrication and construction processes
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, makers, and other industry partners

 **Project Leadership \& Management**

* Take accountability for the successful creative and commercial delivery of projects to TGP’s quality standards
* Maintain oversight and remain actively involved and hands\-on throughout the entire project process, from initial concept through to design development, documentation, and delivery
* Make informed decisions regarding project resourcing, priorities, workflows, and allocation of responsibilities across internal teams including weekly resource tracking and coordination of project scheduling
* Manage projects effectively against agreed programmes, budgets, contractual scope of services, and commercial requirements
* Identify project risks and challenges early and work proactively with leadership team to resolve them
* Provide clear and timely reporting to the leadership team on project progress, resourcing, and key issues

 **Team Development \& Management**

* Foster a collaborative and supportive environment in which knowledge and best practice are openly shared
* Lead, mentor and train junior team members to support their professional and creative development, and maximise team performance and quality design output
* Support department resource planning, forecasting, project allocation and ad\-hoc department admin
* Manage workloads and workflows across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring teams are appropriately supported
* Contribute positively to TGP’s studio culture and help maintain an environment that encourages collaboration and creativity

 **Client Engagement**

* Actively engage with opportunities to develop new business, enhancing internal and external communications via events, forums, and publications
* Support the preparation of fee bids, RFPs, and fee negotiations on projects

 **Software Proficiency**

* Adobe Suite
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* PowerPoint
* Microsoft Office


Experience with the following would be advantageous:

* Miro
* Asana

  

The role is based in our Covent Garden studio in London, with a hybrid working model of three days per week in the studio, and two days working remotely from home.

 **Requirements** **What we are looking for:**


We are looking for an accomplished hospitality designer and creative leader who combines exceptional design ability with strong project, team, and client leadership.


The successful candidate will have:

* 10\+ years' professional experience in interior design or interior architecture, with significant experience in hospitality and F\&B environments
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative quality across restaurants, food halls, bars, and other hospitality and commercial environments having worked through Riba stages 1\-6
* A proven ability to develop emotive, narrative\-driven, and design\-led concepts and experiences, across projects of varying scales and geographies
* Strong creative leadership, with the ability to take projects from initial concept and storytelling through design development and delivery, including technical and construction expertise
* The confidence and experience to operate autonomously, with minimal supervision from leadership team
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience developing and managing design teams
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of project programmes, budgets/value engineering, contracts, fees, and resourcing
* Excellent client\-facing, presentation, and communication skills
* A collaborative, adaptable, no\-ego approach, and a commitment to contributing positively to studio culture
* A bachelor’s degree in interior design, Interior Architecture or a related discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional qualification
* The right to work in the UK

 **Benefits** **TGP International employee benefits:**

* Hybrid work arrangement: three days in the office and two days working remotely
* Company incentive scheme offering up to 5 to 10 per cent for introductions and 5 per cent for successful closures
* Remote work flexibility: one additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

description:
Rite is one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East, making daily nutrition enjoyable through functional gummies and drink mixes.
 



 Founded in Dubai and now operating locally in Saudi Arabia, we're building much more than a supplement brand, we're creating a wellness ecosystem powered by content, community, education, and exceptional products.
 



 Rite is currently available online and in more than 300\+ stores.
 



 We're looking for an entrepreneurial marketing leader who wants to continue building a strong brand, not simply manage and execute.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 As our Marketing \& Growth Manager, you will own the execution of Rite's marketing strategy across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring every customer touchpoint \- from paid advertising and social media to CRM, influencers, and content \- works together to build a premium brand while driving profitable growth.
 



 Rather than executing every task yourself, your role is to lead internal and external partners, challenge ideas, improve creative quality, and make sure every initiative contributes to business growth.
 



 You'll work closely with the founders and become one of the key leaders shaping Rite's future.
 



  





**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Brand \& Creative Leadership** 



* Own Rite's brand positioning across all channels.
* Define the creative direction for advertising and organic content, both online and offline.
* Ensure consistency across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CRM, and the website.
* Challenge and improve every creative before production.
* Build a premium, recognizable wellness brand online and offline.



  





**Performance Marketing** 




 Work closely with our Media Buyer, UGC ads agency, and Creative Strategist by:
 


* Reviewing weekly performance.
* Identifying winning creative angles for the UAE and KSA markets.
* Defining testing priorities with our Creative Strategist and adapting them culturally to both countries.
* Ensuring creative production aligns with performance insights.
* Coordinating creative strategy with media buying.



  





**Content \& Social Media** 




 Own:
 


* Content calendar.
* Social strategy.
* Organic growth.
* Video production for product launches or specific campaigns.
* UGC planning.
* Community building.
* Brand storytelling.



 Coordinate with external UGC agencies and freelance creators.
 



 Manage our in\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive, who will support you with execution.
 



  





**Influencer Strategy** 




 Lead the entire influencer programme strategy by managing our Influencer \& Partnerships Manager and external agencies responsible for execution.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Supporting creator sourcing.
* Supporting negotiations.
* Leading the affiliate strategy and ecosystem.
* Leading the whitelisting strategy.
* Campaign execution.
* Performance reporting.



 Build long\-term relationships with creators across the UAE and Saudi Arabia and ensure that deliverables are properly executed by your team and external agencies.
 



  





**Partnerships \& Brand Activations** 




 Lead Rite's partnership strategy to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and community engagement.
 


* Develop co\-marketing campaigns and brand collaborations.
* Support our Brand Partnerships \& Sales Manager with brand activations, pop\-ups, sampling campaigns, and wellness events.
* Support the creation of packaging, PR boxes, and marketing collateral.
* Manage sponsorship opportunities and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Create partnerships that generate both commercial opportunities and long\-term brand equity.



  





**CRM \& Customer Retention** 




 Be the main point of contact for our CRM agency and support them with strategy and execution.
 



 Own:
 


* Email strategy.
* Customer journeys.
* Campaign calendar.
* Loyalty initiatives.
* Product launches.



  





**Agency Management** 




 Coordinate multiple external partners, including:
 


* Creative agencies.
* UGC agencies and UGC creators.
* Production companies.
* Influencer agencies.
* CRM agency.
* Freelancers, including video editors and graphic designers.



 Ensure everyone works toward the same objectives.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Manage and work closely with:
 


* Creative Strategist, remote.
* In\-house Graphic Designer.
* In\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive.
* Country Manager Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh.



 Create a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, speed, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**We're Looking for Someone Who...** 



* Has 3–5\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands.
* Has extensive experience in performance marketing, offline marketing, content, social media, and influencer management.
* Understands how strong marketing drives acquisition.
* Has managed multiple agencies and cross\-functional teams.
* Has deep knowledge of UAE and Saudi consumer behaviour.
* Understands influencer marketing beyond vanity metrics.
* Thinks commercially, not just creatively.
* Is highly organised and execution\-focused.
* Is proactive, curious, and constantly looking for better ways of doing things.
* Has strong skills in the use of AI to set up efficient systems and SOPs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**The Entrepreneurial Mindset We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions.
 



 We want someone who:
 


* Treats Rite as if it were their own company.
* Challenges existing ideas and proposes better ones.
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks.
* Is obsessed with customer experience and business growth.
* Moves fast, learns quickly, and embraces experimentation.
* Is comfortable wearing multiple hats.
* Makes decisions using both data and intuition.
* Inspires the team through energy, curiosity, and ambition.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A unique opportunity to build one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East from the inside.
* High ownership and autonomy, with the ability to shape our brand, growth strategy, and partnership ecosystem alongside the founders.
* A competitive salary complemented by a performance\-based bonus.
* The chance to recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing marketing team as the company scales.
* Exposure to multiple high\-growth markets, with a strong focus on the UAE and Saudi Arabia and future international expansion.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Company visa, comprehensive health insurance, annual flight ticket, generous annual leave, and the tools you need to perform at your best.
* Flexible working arrangements and the opportunity to travel to Saudi Arabia for key partnerships, product launches, retail activations, and industry events.
* Unlimited access to Rite products and the opportunity to help shape the future of wellness in the region.

title: Ophthalmology Field Director, Medical Science Liaisons
description:
**About this role**

The Ophthalmology Field Director, Medical Science Liaisons (FD) is a leadership role within US Medical Affairs and a strategic partner across Biogen. This role provides leadership, strategic direction, and operational excellence to a regional team of Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), ensuring the effective translation and execution of medical strategy in support of meaningful patient outcomes. Biogen’s priority is to continue to foster and enable a diverse and inclusive workforce – representing age, gender, sexual identity, race, ethnicity, Veterans, and people with disabilities – that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients who we serve.


**What You’ll Do**

Strategic Planning \& Execution


* Collaborate with Medical Directors, brand teams, clinical partners, and cross‑functional stakeholders to develop and implement regional field medical strategies, translating enterprise and brand objectives into clear, actionable plans for the MSL team.
* Establish and monitor KPIs that measure MSL impact and execution against medical and brand strategy, leveraging both leading and lagging indicators to drive continuous improvement.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the therapeutic area, Biogen products, competitive landscape, and evolving regulatory and treatment guidelines to inform field strategy and execution.
* Demonstrate agility in prioritizing and reprioritizing field activities in response to scientific, regulatory, or market changes.

Performance Management \& Coaching


* Lead a clear and consistent operating rhythm, including weekly review of field metrics and KPI dashboards, to inform performance management and targeted, data‑driven coaching.
* Actively manage, coach, and develop MSLs through regular territory coaching and bi‑annual territory reviews in partnership with Medical Leadership, fostering high performance and professional growth.
* Ensure MSLs have complete clarity on medical strategy, aligned engagement plans, and consistent execution against defined KPIs and expectations.
* Be accountable for team performance while fostering a positive, inclusive, and high‑engagement culture aligned with Biogen values.

Medical Insights \& Field Excellence


* Ensure high‑quality, strategically aligned Voice of KOL (VoKOL) insights are gathered compliantly and meet defined quality standards.
* Oversee effective use of field tools and systems (e.g., Veeva, OLA) and ensure HCP targeting and activity documentation align with medical strategy and compliance requirements.
* Drive field modernization by ensuring adoption of approved tools, processes, and best practices that enhance efficiency, insight quality, and scientific impact.
* Ensure timely and effective communication of medical insights to relevant internal stakeholders to inform cross‑functional strategy and tactical planning.

Collaboration, Communication \& Executive Presence


* Serve as the primary regional field medical liaison, enabling strong, compliant collaboration across Medical, MDO, and cross‑functional partners in support of a One Biogen, patient‑centric approach to external engagement.
* Clearly articulate the value proposition of the medical strategy to internal leadership and stakeholders, demonstrating strong business acumen and executive presence.
* Lead, educate, and mentor internal stakeholders on therapeutic area insights, strategic trade‑offs, and the impact of medical decisions on enterprise goals.
* Maintain and contribute to cross‑therapeutic‑area best practice and lessons‑learned sharing to continuously elevate field medical excellence.

**Who You Are**

You are a self\-starter, energetic leader, coach and manager of a team of professionals. You have clinical training with work experience in the healthcare, pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industry. You keep patients, payers and health care providers top of mind in your daily work and collaborate to solve critical scientific and business challenges.


**Required skills**

* 7\+ years of Medical Affairs experience, including MSL experience (required) and Medical strategy experience (highly preferred)
* Advanced scientific or clinical degree required; doctoral level preferred (e.g. MD, PhD, PharmD, DNP).
* Demonstrated leadership and management of effective Medical Affairs teams
* Excellent communication and formal presentation skills, organizational skills, and ability to effectively manage several projects simultaneously
* Able to travel 60% of the time, including ability to travel overnight and occasionally on weekends
* Must have a valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record with authorization and ability to drive a company leased vehicle or rental

**Preferred Skills \& Therapeutic Area Specific Skills**

* Clinical experience and subject matter expertise in the ophthalmology therapeutic area
* 2\+ years’ experience managing a team of field \-based Pharmaceutical/Biotechnology industry employees
* Experience navigating an ultra\-competitive disease state

**Why Biogen?**

Our Company mission to find therapies for neurological and rare diseases is a unique focus within our industry and this shared purpose is what connects us as a team. We work together to overcome obstacles and to follow the science. We are resilient as we strive to make an impact on our patients’ lives and on changing the course of medicine. Together, we pioneer. Together, we thrive.  



  

Job Level: Management  

  

**Additional Information**

The base compensation range for this role is: $222,000\.00\-$305,000\.00  

  

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills \& experience, job location, and internal equity.  



  

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long\-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.  



  

In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families *physical, financial, emotional,* and *social well\-being* ; including, but not limited to:


* Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life insurances
* Fitness \& Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
* Short\- and Long\-Term Disability insurance
* A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end\-of\-year shutdown time off (Dec 26\-Dec 31\)
* Up to 12 company paid holidays \+ 3 paid days off for Personal Significance

* Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
* 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan

Employee Resource Groups participation

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life\-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.  



  

At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space\-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.



OUR VALUES


* **Be the offset.** We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

**YOUR MISSION**



Leaders like you are essential to this mission – to inspire, define, and build. This is some of the most meaningful work you’ll ever do, in an industry devoted to protecting the people you care about.



We’re looking for an inspirational creative leader to found our industrial product design function and build the team around it. With a well\-established and growing software design team we’re now turning our attention to our critical hardware needs. You’ll sit alongside the engineers designing and building spacecraft and space\-based interceptors, bringing your design aesthetics to the toughest hardware problems around, designed to operate flawlessly in the most challenging domain.



You’ll report directly to our Creative Director who’s building this function for people who care as much about the craft as the mission.


**WHY THIS ROLE**



There’s no established playbook for how space security hardware should look. Most on\-orbit hardware looks the way it does because function dictated every element. We believe building a product compelling design language can play a huge part in making our hardware express its function and perform better.



The programs that invest here gain a measurable advantage: in recruiting, in customer confidence, and in the engineering discipline that visible craft quietly enforces.



This is a founding seat. You’ll define what industrial design means here, set the standard, hire the team, and do it while the hardware is still early enough for it to matter. Your work will be inspected at the highest levels of government and military with some of it making it to orbit.



If you’ve ever wanted your craft to carry real weight, this is that job.


**RESPONSIBILITIES** — design leadership for hardware


* Establish industrial design at True Anomaly: the function, the standard, and the working relationship with hardware engineering
* Own the design language of our hardware products through your team and your personal work, You’ll champion great design across the company by demonstrating its value and advocating to our exec and engineering teams.
* Hire and lead a high\-performing team of industrial and product designers
* Look to the future by visualizing visually stunning new concepts, designed to start conversations and inspire. Push us out of our comfort zone and challenge the art of the possible.
* Bring design into engineering and architecture decisions early, working with product engineering leadership early to influence and build great design into our hardware from the beginning.


**QUALIFICATIONS** \- We hire for talent and potential, not pedigree.


* Show us a portfolio of hardware you led or shaped, with a clear account of what you decided and why
* Demonstrate experience leading designers, from hiring to mentoring
* Fluency with engineering constraint. You’ll be working with people solving structural, thermal, and other problems, you need to be credible with them
* Consumer, automotive, aerospace, robotics, medical, and industrial equipment backgrounds all fit. Defense and space knowledge is great, we don’t expect it
* An active security clearance is a bonus, not a requirement.


**WHAT WE EXPECT**


* Leverage your experience to work quickly and efficiently, we’re a lean team, everyone needs to pitch in and move fast. You’ll be building a team, and until that team exists, you’ll be doing the work yourself
* Take ownership of design programs and see them through concept to final execution
